-- RollController: vertical reel, full / minimized modes, auto-roll.
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("RNGConfig"))
local ItemIcon = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("ItemIcon"))
local NumberFormat = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("NumberFormat"))
local remote = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("RollRNG")
local Cutscene = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("RareDropCutscene"))

local gui = script.Parent
local stage = gui:WaitForChild("RollStage")
local aspect = stage:WaitForChild("Aspect")
local slotsFrame = stage:WaitForChild("Slots")
local glow = stage:WaitForChild("Glow")
local glowScale = glow:WaitForChild("UIScale")
local rays = stage:WaitForChild("Rays")
local pointerL, pointerR = stage:WaitForChild("PointerL"), stage:WaitForChild("PointerR")
local dim = gui:WaitForChild("RollDim")
local rollFinished = gui:WaitForChild("RollFinished")
local bottom = gui:WaitForChild("BottomBar")
local rollB, autoB, hideB = bottom:WaitForChild("RollButton"), bottom:WaitForChild("AutoButton"), bottom:WaitForChild("HideButton")

local FONT = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
local BLACK = Color3.fromRGB(10, 10, 12)
local WHITE = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
local GREEN = Color3.fromRGB(90, 255, 90)
local FADED = Color3.fromRGB(80, 80, 92)

local function tween(obj, t, props, style, dir)
	local tw = TweenService:Create(obj, TweenInfo.new(t, style or Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, dir or Enum.EasingDirection.Out), props)
	tw:Play()
	return tw
end

--------------------------------------------------
-- MODES
--------------------------------------------------
local MODES = {
	full = {anchor = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), pos = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.45), size = UDim2.fromScale(0.6, 0.78),
		aspect = 0.5, slot = 0.2, range = 3},
	mini = {anchor = Vector2.new(0.5, 0), pos = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.01), size = UDim2.fromScale(0.3, 0.27),
		aspect = 0.8, slot = 1 / 3.1, range = 1},
}
local minimized = false
local mode = MODES.full

local blur = Instance.new("BlurEffect")
blur.Name = "RollBlur"
blur.Size = 0
blur.Parent = workspace.CurrentCamera

local function updateBackdrop(instant)
	local on = stage.Visible and not minimized
	local t = instant and 0 or 0.25
	tween(blur, t, {Size = on and 22 or 0})
	tween(dim, t, {BackgroundTransparency = on and 0.5 or 1})
end

local function applyMode()
	mode = minimized and MODES.mini or MODES.full
	stage.AnchorPoint = mode.anchor
	stage.Position = mode.pos
	stage.Size = mode.size
	aspect.AspectRatio = mode.aspect
	glow.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, mode.slot * 1.7)
	rays.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, mode.slot * 2.6)
	for _, p in ipairs({pointerL, pointerR}) do p.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.14, mode.slot * 0.42) end
	updateBackdrop(true)
end

--------------------------------------------------
-- REEL (7 recycled slots; slot for absolute index j = slots[j % 7])
--------------------------------------------------
local NSLOTS = 7
local slots = {}
local seq = {}

local function label(parent, props, st)
	local l = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	l.Font = FONT; l.TextScaled = true; l.TextColor3 = WHITE; l.BackgroundTransparency = 1; l.Text = ""
	for k, v in pairs(props) do l[k] = v end
	local s = Instance.new("UIStroke"); s.Thickness = st; s.Color = BLACK; s.LineJoinMode = Enum.LineJoinMode.Round; s.Parent = l
	l.Parent = parent
	return l
end

for i = 1, NSLOTS do
	local cg = Instance.new("CanvasGroup")
	cg.Name = "Slot" .. i
	cg.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	cg.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	cg.Visible = false
	local sc = Instance.new("UIScale"); sc.Parent = cg
	local odds = label(cg, {Name = "Odds", Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.25, 0.03), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.2), TextColor3 = GREEN}, 3)
	local holder = Instance.new("Frame")
	holder.Name = "IconHolder"; holder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	holder.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5); holder.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.48); holder.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.6, 0.5)
	holder.Parent = cg
	local name = label(cg, {Name = "ItemName", Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.04, 0.73), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.92, 0.25)}, 4)
	cg.Parent = slotsFrame
	slots[i] = {cg = cg, scale = sc, odds = odds, holder = holder, name = name, item = nil, pop = 1}
end

-- visual filler items: common ones appear more often, like the real odds
local weightTotal = 0
for _, it in ipairs(Config.Items) do weightTotal += 1 / it.Chance end
local function randomItem()
	local n = math.random() * weightTotal
	for _, it in ipairs(Config.Items) do
		n -= 1 / it.Chance
		if n <= 0 then return it end
	end
	return Config.Items[1]
end
local function itemAt(j)
	if not seq[j] then seq[j] = randomItem() end
	return seq[j]
end

local function setItem(s, item)
	s.item = item
	s.odds.Text = "1 in " .. NumberFormat.Abbreviate(item.Chance)
	s.name.Text = string.upper(item.Name)
	s.holder:ClearAllChildren()
	ItemIcon.create(item).Parent = s.holder
end

local posValue = Instance.new("NumberValue")
posValue.Value = 0
local lastPos, speed = 0, 0

local function render()
	local pos = posValue.Value
	local base = math.floor(pos + 0.5)
	local range = mode.range
	local used = {}
	local motion = math.clamp(speed / 35, 0, 1)
	for j = base - range, base + range do
		local s = slots[(j % NSLOTS) + 1]
		used[s] = true
		local item = itemAt(j)
		if s.item ~= item then setItem(s, item) end
		local d = j - pos
		local ad = math.abs(d)
		s.cg.Visible = true
		s.cg.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, mode.slot)
		s.cg.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5 + d * mode.slot)
		-- fade + darken with distance, extra transparency when moving fast (motion blur feel)
		local fade = math.clamp(ad / (range + 0.5), 0, 1)
		s.cg.GroupTransparency = math.clamp(fade * 0.92 + motion * (ad < 0.5 and 0.25 or 0.45), 0, 1)
		s.cg.GroupColor3 = WHITE:Lerp(FADED, math.clamp(ad * 1.2, 0, 1))
		s.scale.Scale = (1 - math.min(ad, 2) * 0.17) * s.pop
	end
	for _, s in ipairs(slots) do
		if not used[s] then s.cg.Visible = false end
	end
end

-- ROLL AUDIO: crisp prize-wheel ticks tied to item crossings, plus a deeper landing click.
-- RNGGui.RollTickVolume (default 0.32) and RollTickOff still control all roll audio.
--------------------------------------------------
local TICK_SOUND = "rbxassetid://12221976" -- short Roblox clickfast.wav; reshaped below
local TICK_VOLUME = 0.32
local TICK_MAX_PER_SEC = 30
local tickGroup = Instance.new("SoundGroup")
tickGroup.Name = "RollSFX"
tickGroup.Parent = game:GetService("SoundService")
local tone = Instance.new("EqualizerSoundEffect")
tone.Name = "CrispWheelTone"
tone.LowGain = -7
tone.MidGain = 2
tone.HighGain = -1
tone.Parent = tickGroup

local function newTick(name)
 local s = Instance.new("Sound")
 s.Name = name
 s.SoundId = TICK_SOUND
 s.Volume = TICK_VOLUME
 s.SoundGroup = tickGroup
 s.Parent = script
 return s
end
local tickPool = {}
for i = 1, 4 do tickPool[i] = newTick("RollTick" .. i) end
local landingTick = newTick("RollLand")
-- Load early without holding up the UI or the server's roll response.
task.spawn(function()
 pcall(function() game:GetService("ContentProvider"):PreloadAsync({tickPool[1], landingTick}) end)
end)
script.Destroying:Connect(function() tickGroup:Destroy() end)

local function rollVolume()
 local v = gui:GetAttribute("RollTickVolume")
 if type(v) ~= "number" or v ~= v then v = TICK_VOLUME end
 return math.clamp(v, 0, 1) * (minimized and 0.55 or 1)
end
local function muted()
 return gui:GetAttribute("RollTickOff") == true or rollVolume() == 0
end
gui:GetAttributeChangedSignal("RollTickOff"):Connect(function()
 if muted() then
  for _,s in tickPool do s:Stop() end
  landingTick:Stop()
 end
end)

local tickIndex, lastTickAt, lastTickSlot = 0, -math.huge, nil
local function playTick(reelSpeed)
 if muted() or Cutscene.IsPlaying() then return end
 local now = os.clock()
 if now - lastTickAt < 1 / TICK_MAX_PER_SEC then return end
 lastTickAt = now
 tickIndex = tickIndex % #tickPool + 1
 local s = tickPool[tickIndex]
 local animScale = game.Players.LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("RollAnimScale") or 1
 local upgrades = math.clamp((1 - animScale) / 0.4, 0, 1)
 if gui:GetAttribute("FastRolls") then upgrades = 1 end
 local motion = math.clamp(reelSpeed / 40, 0, 1)
 s.PlaybackSpeed = 1.02 + upgrades * 0.20 + motion * 0.12 + (math.random() - 0.5) * 0.025
 s.Volume = rollVolume() * (0.82 + 0.18 * motion)
 s.TimePosition = 0
 s:Play()
end
local function playLandingTick()
 if muted() or Cutscene.IsPlaying() then return end
 landingTick.PlaybackSpeed = 0.90
 landingTick.Volume = math.min(rollVolume() * 1.15, 1)
 landingTick.TimePosition = 0
 landingTick:Play()
end

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
 local p = posValue.Value
 speed = math.abs(p - lastPos) / math.max(dt, 1e-3)
 lastPos = p
 rays.Rotation = (rays.Rotation + dt * 20) % 360
 if stage.Visible then
  render()
  local slot = math.floor(p + 0.5)
  if lastTickSlot and slot ~= lastTickSlot then playTick(speed) end
  lastTickSlot = slot
 else
  lastTickSlot = nil
 end
end)

--------------------------------------------------
-- ROLL
--------------------------------------------------
local rolling, rollId, lastFire = false, 0, 0
local waiting
remote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(result, counts, equipped, luck)
	if waiting then waiting(result, counts, equipped, luck) end
end)

local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
local punching = false
local function fovPunch()
	if punching then return end
	punching = true
	local base = camera.FieldOfView
	tween(camera, 0.08, {FieldOfView = base - 6}).Completed:Wait()
	tween(camera, 0.35, {FieldOfView = base}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back).Completed:Wait()
	punching = false
end

local function showStage()
	gui:SetAttribute("Rolling", true)
	if not stage.Visible then
		stage.Visible = true
		render()
		updateBackdrop()
	end
end
local function hideStage()
	gui:SetAttribute("Rolling", false)
	stage.Visible = false
	updateBackdrop()
end

local function doRoll()
	if rolling or gui:GetAttribute("RebirthMenuOpen") or game.Players.LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("IntroPlaying") then return end
	rolling = true
	rollId += 1
	local myId = rollId

	local animScale = game.Players.LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("RollAnimScale") or 1
	local gap = (Config.RollCooldown * animScale + 0.1) - (os.clock() - lastFire)
	if gap > 0 then task.wait(gap) end

	local result, counts, equipped, luck
	waiting = function(r, c, e, l) result, counts, equipped, luck = r, c, e, l end
	lastFire = os.clock()
	remote:FireServer()

	showStage()
	tween(rays, 0.2, {GroupTransparency = 0.55})
	tween(glowScale, 0.2, {Scale = 1})

	-- creep the reel while the server answers
	local t0 = os.clock()
	while result == nil and os.clock() - t0 < 3 do
		posValue.Value += 0.15
		task.wait()
	end
	waiting = nil
	if not result then
		rolling = false
		hideStage()
		return
	end

	local fast = gui:GetAttribute("FastRolls")
	local base = math.floor(posValue.Value + 0.5)
	local dist = fast and 8 or (26 + math.random(0, 6))
	local target = base + dist
	for j = base + 1, target + 4 do seq[j] = randomItem() end
	seq[target] = Config.ByName[result] or Config.Items[1]
	for j in pairs(seq) do
		if j < base - 10 then seq[j] = nil end -- keep memory tiny
	end

	-- decelerate, overshoot a touch, settle back onto the winner
	local wonItem = Config.ByName[result]
	local hadRareCutscene = Cutscene.ShouldPlay(wonItem, luck)
	if hadRareCutscene then
		-- RARE: reel starts, then the screen cuts to black for the cutscene
		local tw = tween(posValue, 3.1, {Value = target + 0.22}, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
		task.wait(0.9)
		Cutscene.Play(wonItem, luck, (counts and counts[result]) == 1) -- 2026-10-04: NEW badge on first copies
		tw:Cancel()
		posValue.Value = target
	else
		tween(posValue, fast and 0.7 or 3.1 * animScale, {Value = target + 0.22}, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint).Completed:Wait()
		tween(posValue, 0.35, {Value = target}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back).Completed:Wait()
	end

	if not hadRareCutscene then playLandingTick() end

	-- winner!
	local win = slots[(target % NSLOTS) + 1]
	local popV = Instance.new("NumberValue")
	popV.Value = 1.3
	popV.Changed:Connect(function(v) win.pop = v end)
	win.pop = 1.3
	tween(popV, 0.4, {Value = 1}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back).Completed:Connect(function() popV:Destroy(); win.pop = 1 end)
	glowScale.Scale = 1.5
	tween(glowScale, 0.5, {Scale = 1.2}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
	rays.GroupTransparency = 0
	tween(rays, 1.2, {GroupTransparency = 0.3})
	if (Config.ByName[result] and Config.ByName[result].Chance or 0) >= Config.BigRollAt then
		task.spawn(fovPunch)
	end

	rollFinished:Fire(result, counts, equipped)
	rolling = false

	task.delay(1.8, function()
		if rollId == myId and not rolling then hideStage() end
	end)
end

--------------------------------------------------
-- BUTTONS
--------------------------------------------------
local function bounce(btn)
	local s = btn:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
	if not s then return end
	btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function() tween(s, 0.12, {Scale = 1.1}) end)
	btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function() tween(s, 0.12, {Scale = 1}) end)
	btn.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function() tween(s, 0.08, {Scale = 0.88}) end)
	btn.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function() tween(s, 0.25, {Scale = 1.1}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back) end)
end
-- hover/click/idle visuals for these buttons live in BottomBarFX

rollB.Activated:Connect(function() task.spawn(doRoll) end)

local auto = false
local autoLabel = autoB:WaitForChild("Label")
autoB.Activated:Connect(function()
	auto = not auto
	autoB:SetAttribute("On", auto)
	autoLabel.Text = auto and 'AUTO-ROLL <font color="#5AFF5A">ON</font>' or "AUTO-ROLL OFF"
	if auto then
		task.spawn(function()
			while auto do
				doRoll()
				task.wait(0.7 * (game.Players.LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("RollAnimScale") or 1))
			end
		end)
	end
end)

local hideLabel = hideB:WaitForChild("Label")

-- 2026-10-04 (Claude): the reel is not clickable at all any more. It used to carry a full-size 'tap to show' button, which was useless and
-- also blocked clicks on whatever is behind the small reel (UNLOCK signs, upgrade tiles). HIDE ROLL (shown only while the big reel is
-- on screen) is the one switch; the Upgrades page forces the small reel through RollForceMini.
local userMin, forceMini = false, false
local function applyMinimized()
	minimized = userMin or forceMini
	hideLabel.Text = minimized and "SHOW ROLL" or "HIDE ROLL"
	gui:SetAttribute("RollMinimized", minimized)
	applyMode()
end
local function setMinimized(v)
	userMin = v
	applyMinimized()
end
hideB.Activated:Connect(function() setMinimized(not userMin) end)
-- 2026-10-04 (Claude): UpgradeTreeClient sets RollForceMini while the Upgrades screen is open -> the small reel at the top
gui:GetAttributeChangedSignal("RollForceMini"):Connect(function()
	forceMini = gui:GetAttribute("RollForceMini") == true
	applyMinimized()
end)

applyMode()

-- STUDIO ONLY: press P to preview the rare-drop cutscene with a random rare shovel
if RunService:IsStudio() then
	game:GetService("UserInputService").InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
		if processed or input.KeyCode ~= Enum.KeyCode.P or Cutscene.IsPlaying() or game.Players.LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("IntroPlaying") then return end
		local pool = {}
		for _, it in ipairs(Config.Items) do
			if Cutscene.ShouldPlay(it, 1) then table.insert(pool, it) end
		end
		if #pool > 0 then task.spawn(Cutscene.Play, pool[math.random(#pool)], 1, true) end
	end)
end

-- DOUBLE ROLL: little banner when the upgrade gives a bonus shovel
do
	local toast = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	toast.Name = "DoubleRollToast"
	toast.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
	toast.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.14)
	toast.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.45, 0.06)
	toast.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	toast.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
	toast.TextScaled = true
	toast.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 80)
	toast.TextTransparency = 1
	toast.ZIndex = 30
	local st = Instance.new("UIStroke"); st.Thickness = 3; st.Transparency = 1; st.Parent = toast
	toast.Parent = gui
	remote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(_, _, _, _, extra)
		if not extra then return end
		task.delay(3.4 * (game.Players.LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("RollAnimScale") or 1), function()
			toast.Text = "🎲 DOUBLE ROLL!  +" .. extra
			toast.TextTransparency = 0; st.Transparency = 0
			task.wait(2)
			tween(toast, 0.4, {TextTransparency = 1})
			tween(st, 0.4, {Transparency = 1})
		end)
	end)
end

-- Wiggles the "30% OFF" badge on the Shop icon.
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local badge = script.Parent:WaitForChild("LeftMenu"):WaitForChild("ShopButton"):WaitForChild("SaleBadge")
local scale = badge:WaitForChild("UIScale")
local b1, b2 = badge:WaitForChild("Burst1"), badge:WaitForChild("Burst2")
local pct = badge:WaitForChild("Percent")

local function updateText()
	pct.Text = tostring(badge:GetAttribute("Percent") or 30) .. "%"
end
badge:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Percent"):Connect(updateText)
updateText()

local t = 0
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
	if not badge.Visible then return end
	t += dt
	local cycle = t % 3
	-- quick attention wiggle at the start of every 3 seconds, calm sway the rest of the time
	local wiggle = cycle < 0.7 and math.sin(cycle * 38) * 20 * (1 - cycle / 0.7) or 0
	badge.Rotation = -10 + math.sin(t * 2) * 4 + wiggle
	local pop = cycle < 0.18 and 0.15 * (1 - cycle / 0.18) or 0
	scale.Scale = 1 + math.sin(t * 4) * 0.04 + pop
	-- starburst slowly spins behind the text
	b1.Rotation = (t * 30) % 360
	b2.Rotation = (t * 30 + 45) % 360
end)

local function mk(class, props, parent)
	local o = Instance.new(class)
	for k, v in pairs(props) do o[k] = v end
	o.Parent = parent
	return o
end
local function reduced() return player:GetAttribute("TreasureReduced") == true end

local function playSound(rarity, volumeScale)
	if player:GetAttribute("TreasureSoundOff") then return end
	local s = SOUNDS[rarity]
	local snd = mk("Sound", {SoundId = s.Id, Volume = s.Volume * (volumeScale or 1), PlaybackSpeed = s.Speed}, SoundService)
	snd:Play()
	task.delay(s.Len, function()
		TweenService:Create(snd, TweenInfo.new(0.35), {Volume = 0}):Play()
		task.wait(0.4)
		snd:Destroy()
	end)
end

local function fxPart(props)
	local p = Instance.new("Part")
	p.Anchored, p.CanCollide, p.CanQuery, p.CanTouch, p.CastShadow = true, false, false, false, false
	p.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	p.Size = Vector3.new(0.3, 0.3, 0.3)
	for k, v in pairs(props) do p[k] = v end
	p.Parent = fxFolder
	return p
end

local function burst(pos, texture, colorSeq, count, size, speed, life, gravity)
	local a = fxPart({Transparency = 1, Size = Vector3.new(0.4, 0.4, 0.4), CFrame = CFrame.new(pos)})
	local e = mk("ParticleEmitter", {Enabled = false, Rate = 0, Texture = texture, Color = colorSeq, LightEmission = (texture == SPARKLE) and 1 or 0,
		Size = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, size), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0)}),
		Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1)}),
		Lifetime = NumberRange.new(life * 0.6, life), Speed = NumberRange.new(speed * 0.5, speed), SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(60, 60),
		Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, -gravity, 0), EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Top}, a)
	e:Emit(count)
	task.delay(life + 0.3, function() a:Destroy() end)
end

-- glowing ring of beads that expands across the ground under the treasure
local function ringBurst(pos, color, diameter, count, delay)
	task.delay(delay or 0, function()
		local beads = {}
		for i = 1, count do beads[i] = fxPart({Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball, Size = Vector3.new(0.28, 0.28, 0.28), Color = color or hue(0, i / count)}) end
		local t0 = os.clock()
		while true do
			local a = math.clamp((os.clock() - t0) / 0.65, 0, 1)
			local r = 0.6 + (diameter / 2 - 0.6) * (1 - (1 - a) ^ 3)
			for i, b in ipairs(beads) do
				local ang = i / count * math.pi * 2
				b.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos + Vector3.new(math.cos(ang) * r, 0.3, math.sin(ang) * r))
				b.Transparency = 0.1 + 0.9 * a
			end
			if a >= 1 then break end
			RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
		end
		for _, b in ipairs(beads) do b:Destroy() end
	end)
end

local function revealModel(entry)

	local st = STYLE[item.Rarity]

	if not root or not pos or (root.Position - pos).Magnitude > MAX_DISTANCE then return end

	local colorSeq = st.Rainbow and RAINBOW or ColorSequence.new(rar.Color, WHITE)
	-- 1) a short puff of snow + rarity sparkles
	burst(pos + Vector3.new(0, 0.6, 0), SMOKE, ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(245, 250, 255)), red and 5 or 10, 1.0, 9, 0.6, 18)
	if not red then burst(pos + Vector3.new(0, 0.8, 0), SPARKLE, colorSeq, st.Sparks, 0.45, 9, 0.9, 6) end
	if st.Burst and not red then burst(pos + Vector3.new(0, 1.2, 0), SPARKLE, ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(200, 120, 255), Color3.fromRGB(255, 180, 255)), 18, 0.6, 12, 0.7, 2) end
	-- 2) the treasure picture pops out, flips and hovers on a rarity glow (billboard, always faces the camera)
	local holder = fxPart({Transparency = 1, Size = Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2), CFrame = CFrame.new(pos)})
	local bb = mk("BillboardGui", {Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.1, 0.1), LightInfluence = 0, MaxDistance = 220, ResetOnSpawn = false}, holder)
	local glow = mk("Frame", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromScale(1.1, 1.1),
		BackgroundColor3 = st.Rainbow and WHITE or rar.Color, BackgroundTransparency = red and 0.75 or 0.45, ZIndex = 1}, bb)
	mk("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)}, glow)
	mk("UIStroke", {Thickness = 3, Color = WHITE, Transparency = 0.3}, glow)
	local glowGrad = st.Rainbow and mk("UIGradient", {Color = RAINBOW}, glow) or nil
	local iconBox = mk("Frame", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 2}, bb)
	TreasureIcon.Create(item, {ZIndex = 2}).Parent = iconBox
	if st.Light > 0 then mk("PointLight", {Brightness = red and st.Light * 0.6 or st.Light, Range = 9, Color = rar.Color}, holder) end
	-- 3) a glowing ring expands beneath it
	ringBurst(pos, (not st.Rainbow) and rar.Color or nil, st.Ring * (red and 0.7 or 1), red and 12 or st.Beads, 0)
	if (st.Rays or st.Stars) and not red then ringBurst(pos, (not st.Rainbow) and rar.Color or nil, st.Ring * 1.35, st.Beads, 0.28) end
	local extras = {}
	if st.Rays and not red then
		for i = 1, 6 do extras[#extras + 1] = {ray = true, i = i, p = fxPart({Size = Vector3.new(0.16, 2.8, 0.16), Transparency = 0.4,
			Color = st.Rainbow and hue(0, i / 6) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 90)})} end
	end
	if st.Stars and not red then
		for i = 1, 4 do extras[#extras + 1] = {i = i, p = fxPart({Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball, Size = Vector3.new(0.4, 0.4, 0.4),
			Color = st.Rainbow and hue(0, i / 4) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 245, 200)})} end
	end
	playSound(item.Rarity)
	local BASE = 3.4 -- studs
	local start, top = pos + Vector3.new(0, 0.6, 0), pos + Vector3.new(0, 5.2, 0) -- hovers above head height so the player never hides it
	local hover = red and math.min(st.Hover, 0.35) or st.Hover
	local t0, finished = os.clock(), false
	local conn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		local t = os.clock() - t0
		local center, size, flip, tilt = top, BASE, 1, 0
		if t < st.Rise then
			local a = t / st.Rise
			local e = TweenService:GetValue(a, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
			center = start:Lerp(top, e)
			size = BASE * math.clamp(e, 0.05, 1.15)
			flip = math.abs(math.cos(a * math.pi * 2)) -- two quick flips while it pops out
		elseif t < st.Rise + hover then
			local h = t - st.Rise
			center = top + Vector3.new(0, math.sin(h * 4) * 0.16, 0)
			tilt = math.sin(h * 3) * 6
		else
			-- 4) it flies to the player and shrinks into the reward toast
			local a = math.clamp((t - st.Rise - hover) / st.Fly, 0, 1)
			local e = TweenService:GetValue(a, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In)
			local target = (root.Parent and root.Position or top) + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
			center = top:Lerp(target, e)
			size = BASE * (1 - 0.85 * e)
			if a >= 1 then finished = true end
		end
		holder.CFrame = CFrame.new(center)
		bb.Size = UDim2.new(size, 0, size, 0)
		iconBox.Size = UDim2.fromScale(math.max(flip, 0.06), 1)
		iconBox.Rotation = tilt
		if glowGrad then glowGrad.Rotation = (t * 90) % 360 end
		local leaving = t > st.Rise + hover
		for _, x in ipairs(extras) do
			if leaving then
				x.p.Transparency = 1
			elseif x.ray then
				x.p.CFrame = CFrame.new(center) * CFrame.Angles(0, x.i / 6 * math.pi * 2 + t * 0.9, 0) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(62), 0, 0) * CFrame.new(0, 1.9, 0)
				x.p.Transparency = 0.4 + 0.15 * math.sin(t * 3 + x.i)
			else
				local b = t * 2.4 + x.i / 4 * math.pi * 2
				x.p.CFrame = CFrame.new(center + Vector3.new(math.cos(b) * 2.1, 0.25 + math.sin(t * 3 + x.i) * 0.3, math.sin(b) * 2.1))
			end
		end
	end)
	local deadline = os.clock() + st.Rise + hover + st.Fly + 2
	while not finished and os.clock() < deadline do task.wait() end
	conn:Disconnect()
	for _, x in ipairs(extras) do x.p:Destroy() end
	holder:Destroy()
	if root.Parent then burst(root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0), SPARKLE, colorSeq, red and 3 or 8, 0.3, 4, 0.5, 0) end
end

local function showToast(entry)
	iconHolder:ClearAllChildren()
	if entry.merged then
		TreasureIcon.Create({Image = TC.Images and TC.Images.MenuIcon or nil, Emoji = "🎁"}).Parent = iconHolder
		nameL.Text = "+" .. entry.merged .. " MORE TREASURES"

		snowL.Text = "+" .. NumberFormat.Abbreviate(entry.snow) .. " ❄"
		countL.Text = ""

	else
		local info, item, rar = entry.info, entry.item, entry.rar
		TreasureIcon.Create(item).Parent = iconHolder
		nameL.Text = item.Name
		rarL.Text = string.upper(item.Rarity)
		rarGrad.Color = item.Rarity == "Mythic" and RAINBOW or ColorSequence.new(rar.Color)
		toastGrad.Color = item.Rarity == "Mythic" and RAINBOW or ColorSequence.new(rar.Color:Lerp(WHITE, 0.6), rar.Color:Lerp(WHITE, 0.1))
		snowL.Text = "+" .. NumberFormat.Abbreviate(info.Snow or 0) .. " ❄"
		countL.Text = "x" .. tostring(info.Count or 1)
		newBadge.Visible = info.New == true
		hintL.Visible = info.First == true
	end
	toast.Visible = true
	toast.Position = HIDDEN
	TweenService:Create(toast, TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Back), {Position = SHOWN}):Play()
	local hold = entry.hold or 1.8
	if #toastQueue > 0 then hold = math.min(hold, 1.1) end
	task.wait(0.35 + hold)
	TweenService:Create(toast, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {Position = HIDDEN}):Play()
	task.wait(0.28)
	toast.Visible = false
end
local function lowPriority(e) return not e.info.New and e.rar.Order <= 2 end
local function pushToast(entry)
	entry.hold = STYLE[entry.item.Rarity].Hold
	if #toastQueue >= MAX_TOASTS then
		for i, e in ipairs(toastQueue) do
			if lowPriority(e) then table.remove(toastQueue, i); mergedN += 1; mergedSnow += e.info.Snow or 0; break end
		end
		if #toastQueue >= MAX_TOASTS and lowPriority(entry) then mergedN += 1; mergedSnow += entry.info.Snow or 0; return end
	end
	table.insert(toastQueue, entry)
end
task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		local e = table.remove(toastQueue, 1)
		if e then
			local ok, err = pcall(showToast, e)
			if not ok then warn("[TreasureReveal] toast: " .. tostring(err)) end
		elseif mergedN > 0 then
			local n, s = mergedN, mergedSnow
			mergedN, mergedSnow = 0, 0
			pcall(showToast, {merged = n, snow = s, hold = 1.5})
		else
			task.wait(0.1)
		end
	end
end)

local function newTile(id, pos, n, parent)
	local holder = mk("Frame", {Name = id, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(pos.X, pos.Y),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(R * SQ3, R * 2), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 2, Visible = false}, parent)
	local t = {id = id, node = n, holder = holder, pos = pos, state = "hidden", phase = math.random() * 6.28}
	t.scale = mk("UIScale", {Scale = 1}, holder)
	t.glow, t.glowRects = hexShape(holder, R + 10, WHITE, 1, "Glow")
	t.border, t.borderRects = hexShape(holder, R, WHITE, 2, "Border")
	t.fill, t.fillRects = hexShape(holder, R - 5, WHITE, 3, "Fill")
	t.shine, t.shineRects = hexShape(holder, (R - 5) * 0.8, WHITE, 4, "Shine") -- concentric inner hexagon
	t.icon = mk("ImageLabel", {Name = "Icon", BackgroundTransparency = 1, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = ICON_POS,
		Size = ICON_SIZE, ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit, Image = (n and n.Icon) or "", ZIndex = 5, Visible = false}, holder)
	if n and n.IconTint then t.icon.ImageColor3 = n.IconTint end
	if n and n.IconRainbow then
		mk("UIGradient", {Rotation = 35, Color = ColorSequence.new({ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(255, 95, 120)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.25, Color3.fromRGB(255, 190, 60)),
			ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromRGB(120, 230, 120)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.75, Color3.fromRGB(90, 170, 255)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(200, 115, 255))})}, t.icon)
	end
	t.name = text(holder, "", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.45), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.86, 0.27), TextWrapped = true, ZIndex = 6}, 2.5)
	t.nameStroke = t.name:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
	t.sub = text(holder, "", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.7), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.74, 0.15), ZIndex = 6}, 2.5)
	t.q = text(holder, "?", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.52), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.6, 0.56),
		TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 160, 192), ZIndex = 6, Visible = false}, 3)

		Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.95, 0.8), ZIndex = 9}, holder)
	return t
end

local function setLook(t, state, nameText, subText, subColor, showIcon)
	local st = STYLE[state]
	paint(t.fillRects, st.fill, 0)
	paint(t.borderRects, st.border, 0)
	paint(t.shineRects, st.fill:Lerp(WHITE, 1 - st.shine), 0)
	if st.glow then paint(t.glowRects, GLOWBASE:Lerp(st.glow, 0.5), 0); t.glow.Visible = true else t.glow.Visible = false end
	local mystery = state == "mystery"
	t.q.Visible = mystery
	t.name.Visible = not mystery
	t.icon.Visible = showIcon and not mystery
	t.name.Text = nameText or ""
	t.sub.Text = subText or ""
	t.sub.Visible = not mystery and (subText or "") ~= ""
	t.sub.TextColor3 = subColor or WHITE
	if t.nameStroke then t.nameStroke.Thickness = t.icon.Visible and 3 or 2.5 end
	if t.icon.Visible then
		t.name.Position = ICON_NAME_POS; t.name.Size = ICON_NAME_SIZE
		t.sub.Position = ICON_SUB_POS; t.sub.Size = ICON_SUB_SIZE
	else
		t.name.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.42); t.name.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.86, 0.27)
		t.sub.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.68); t.sub.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.74, 0.15)
	end
end

local function float(t, msg, color)
	local board = t.holder.Parent
	local l = text(board, msg, {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(t.pos.X, t.pos.Y - R * 0.8), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(R * 4, R * 0.55),
		TextColor3 = color, ZIndex = 40}, 3)

	local s = l:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")

local function shake(t)
	local base = UDim2.fromOffset(t.pos.X, t.pos.Y)
	for i, dx in ipairs({-9, 9, -7, 7, -3, 0}) do
		task.delay(i * 0.035, function() t.holder.Position = base + UDim2.fromOffset(dx, 0) end)
	end
end
local CONFETTI = {Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 60), Color3.fromRGB(90, 255, 130), Color3.fromRGB(80, 190, 255), Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 170), Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 50)}
local function burst(t)
	local board = t.holder.Parent
	for i = 1, 14 do
		local a = (i / 14) * math.pi * 2 + math.random() * 0.4
		local d = R * (1.1 + math.random() * 0.9)
		local c = mk("Frame", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(t.pos.X, t.pos.Y), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10),
			Rotation = math.random(0, 90), BackgroundColor3 = CONFETTI[(i % #CONFETTI) + 1], BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 35}, board)
		mk("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.3, 0)}, c)
		tween(c, 0.6, {Position = UDim2.fromOffset(t.pos.X + math.cos(a) * d, t.pos.Y + math.sin(a) * d), Rotation = c.Rotation + 180, BackgroundTransparency = 1}, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)
		task.delay(0.65, function() c:Destroy() end)
	end
end

local function showTip(t)
	hovered = t
	if UserInputService.TouchEnabled and not UserInputService.MouseEnabled then return end
	local n = t.node
	if t.isLink then
		tipName.Text = t.linkTitle
		tipName.TextColor3 = STYLE.link.fill
		tipDesc.Text = t.linkDesc
		tipStroke.Color = STYLE.link.fill
	elseif t.state == "mystery" then
		tipName.Text = "???"
		tipName.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(170, 180, 210)
		tipDesc.Text = "Buy a hexagon attached to it to reveal it"
		tipStroke.Color = STYLE.mystery.border
	else
		tipName.Text = n.Name
		tipName.TextColor3 = U.TreeById[n.Tree].Color
		local extra = t.state == "owned" and "Owned" or (t.lock or ("Cost: " .. NumberFormat.Abbreviate(U.CostOf(n)) .. " snow"))
		tipDesc.Text = (n.Text or "") .. "   |   " .. extra
		tipStroke.Color = STYLE[t.state].fill
	end
	tip.Visible = true
end
local function hideTip(t)
	if hovered == t then hovered = nil; tip.Visible = false end
end

local busy = false
local lastFeedback = {}
local function onTileClick(t)
	local n = t.node
	local now = os.clock()
	if t.state ~= "buy" and lastFeedback[t] and now - lastFeedback[t] < 0.3 then return end
	lastFeedback[t] = now
	if t.state == "buy" then
		if busy then return end
		busy = true
		local ok, res, reason = pcall(function() return buyRemote:InvokeServer(n.Id) end)
		busy = false
		if ok and res == true then
			buySound:Play()
			t.scale.Scale = 1.35
			tween(t.scale, 0.45, {Scale = 1}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
			burst(t)
			float(t, n.Text or "Bought!", Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 150))
			refresh(true)
		else
			denySound:Play()
			shake(t)
			float(t, tostring((ok and reason) or "Try again"), Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 130))
			refresh(false)
		end
	elseif t.state == "cant" then
		denySound:Play()
		shake(t)
		local need = U.CostOf(n) - snow()
		float(t, t.lock or ("Need " .. NumberFormat.Abbreviate(math.max(need, 0)) .. " more snow"), Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 130))
	elseif t.state == "mystery" then
		shake(t)
		float(t, "Buy one next to it first", Color3.fromRGB(190, 200, 225))
	end
end

local function visiblePoints(v)
	local pts = {}
	for _, t in pairs(tiles) do
		if t.view == v and t.state ~= "hidden" then table.insert(pts, t.pos) end
	end
	if v == "Main" and miscLink.holder.Visible then table.insert(pts, miscLink.pos) end
	if #pts == 0 then table.insert(pts, Vector2.zero) end
	return pts
end
local function fitTo(v, animated)
	local b = boards[v]
	local points = visiblePoints(v)
	local minX, maxX, minY, maxY = math.huge, -math.huge, math.huge, -math.huge
	for _, p in ipairs(points) do
		minX = math.min(minX, p.X); maxX = math.max(maxX, p.X); minY = math.min(minY, p.Y); maxY = math.max(maxY, p.Y)
	end
	local viewSize = bg.AbsoluteSize
	if viewSize.X < 10 then viewSize = workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize end
	local w, h = (maxX - minX) + R * 2.6, (maxY - minY) + R * 2.8
	local s = math.clamp(math.min(viewSize.X * 0.84 / w, viewSize.Y * 0.58 / h), math.clamp(viewSize.X / 1450, 0.6, 0.95), 1.15)
	local cx, cy = (minX + maxX) / 2, (minY + maxY) / 2
	local target = UDim2.new(0.5, -cx * s, 0.5, -cy * s)
	if animated then
		tween(b.frame, 0.5, {Position = target}, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
		tween(b.scale, 0.5, {Scale = s}, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
	else
		b.frame.Position = target
		b.scale.Scale = s
	end
end

refresh = function(animate)
	local owned, stages, money = ownedSet(), stageSet(), snow()
	local states, done = {}, 0
	local snowStart = owned["S_Center"] == true
	for id in pairs(owned) do states[id] = "owned"; done += 1 end
	local frontier = {}
	for id, n in pairs(U.ById) do
		if not owned[id] then
			local front
			if id == "R_Luck1" then front = snowStart          -- the branch: Lucky Start opens once Snow Start is owned
			elseif n.Center then front = true                  -- Snow Start, Misc Start
			else
				for _, nb in ipairs(U.Neighbours(n)) do if owned[nb.Id] then front = true; break end end
			end
			if front then table.insert(frontier, n) end
		end
	end
	local lockText, miscGreen = {}, 0
	for _, n in ipairs(frontier) do
		local reason = U.LockReason(n, owned, stages)
		if n.Id == "R_Luck1" and reason ~= nil and not n.RequiredStage then reason = nil end
		if reason == nil and money >= U.CostOf(n) then
			states[n.Id] = "buy"
			if n.Tree == "Misc" then miscGreen += 1 end
		else
			states[n.Id] = "cant"
			if reason then
				local st = StageConfig.ById and StageConfig.ById[n.RequiredStage]
				lockText[n.Id] = "Unlock " .. ((st and st.Name) or n.RequiredStage or "the next area") .. " first"
			end
		end
	end
	for _, n in ipairs(frontier) do
		for _, nb in ipairs(U.Neighbours(n)) do if not states[nb.Id] then states[nb.Id] = "mystery" end end
	end

	progressLabel.Text = done .. " / " .. TOTAL .. " owned"
	table.clear(pulsing)
	for id, t in pairs(tiles) do
		local st = states[id] or "hidden"
		local prev = t.state
		t.state = st
		if st == "hidden" then
			t.holder.Visible = false
		else
			local n = t.node
			local hasIcon = (n.Icon or "") ~= ""
			t.lock = lockText[id]
			if st == "owned" then
				setLook(t, st, n.Name, n.Text, Color3.fromRGB(205, 230, 255), hasIcon)
			elseif st == "buy" then
				setLook(t, st, n.Name, "❄ " .. NumberFormat.Abbreviate(U.CostOf(n)), WHITE, hasIcon)
				table.insert(pulsing, t)
			elseif st == "cant" then
				local stg = StageConfig.ById and n.RequiredStage and StageConfig.ById[n.RequiredStage]
				local sub = t.lock and ("🔒 " .. ((stg and stg.Name) or n.RequiredStage or "")) or ("❄ " .. NumberFormat.Abbreviate(U.CostOf(n)))
				setLook(t, st, n.Name, sub, Color3.fromRGB(255, 235, 120), hasIcon)
				table.insert(pulsing, t)
			else
				setLook(t, st, "", "", WHITE, false)
			end
			t.holder.Visible = true
			if animate and prev == "hidden" then
				t.scale.Scale = 0.15
				tween(t.scale, 0.45, {Scale = 1}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
			end
		end
	end
	-- stone path + MISC link grow out of Snow Start (also shown if older saves already own Rolls/Misc tiles)
	local anyRolls, anyMisc, miscOwned = false, false, 0
	for id in pairs(owned) do
		local n = U.ById[id]
		if n and n.Tree == "Rolls" then anyRolls = true end
		if n and n.Tree == "Misc" then anyMisc = true; miscOwned += 1 end
	end
	local showPath = snowStart or anyRolls
	for i, p in ipairs(pathTiles) do
		if showPath and not p.shown then
			p.shown = true
			p.holder.Visible = true
			if animate then
				p.scale.Scale = 0.1
				task.delay(i * 0.08, function() tween(p.scale, 0.35, {Scale = 1}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back) end)
			end
		elseif not showPath then
			p.shown = false
			p.holder.Visible = false
		end
	end
	local showMisc = snowStart or anyMisc
	local wasHidden = not miscLink.holder.Visible
	miscLink.holder.Visible = showMisc
	if showMisc and wasHidden and animate then
		miscLink.scale.Scale = 0.15
		tween(miscLink.scale, 0.45, {Scale = 1}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
	end
	miscLink.sub.Text = miscOwned .. "/" .. #U.TreeById.Misc.Nodes
	miscLink.sub.Visible = true
	miscLink.badge.Visible = miscGreen > 0
	miscLink.badgeLabel.Text = tostring(miscGreen)
	backLink.holder.Visible = view == "Misc"
	if hovered then showTip(hovered) end
end

switchView = function(v)
	view = v
	for name, b in pairs(boards) do b.frame.Visible = name == v end
	title.Text = v == "Misc" and "MISC UPGRADES" or "UPGRADES"
	tip.Visible = false
	hovered = nil
	refresh(false)
	local b = boards[v]
	fitTo(v, false)
	local s = b.scale.Scale
	b.scale.Scale = s * 0.8
	tween(b.scale, 0.35, {Scale = s}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
end

-- flashing: green/red tiles pulse their glow and brighten; yellow links breathe
local pulseConn
local function startPulse()
	if pulseConn then return end
	pulseConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		local now = os.clock()
		for _, t in ipairs(pulsing) do
			local st = STYLE[t.state]
			if st and st.glow then
				local a = 0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(now * (t.state == "buy" and 5.5 or 4) + t.phase)
				local g = GLOWBASE:Lerp(st.glow, 0.25 + 0.65 * a)
				for _, r in ipairs(t.glowRects) do r.BackgroundColor3 = g end
				local c = st.fill:Lerp(WHITE, 0.22 * a)
				for _, r in ipairs(t.fillRects) do r.BackgroundColor3 = c end
				local s2 = c:Lerp(WHITE, 1 - st.shine)
				for _, r in ipairs(t.shineRects) do r.BackgroundColor3 = s2 end
			end
		end
		for _, l in pairs(links) do
			local a = 0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(now * 2.2 + l.phase)
			local g = GLOWBASE:Lerp(STYLE.link.glow, 0.3 + 0.5 * a)
			for _, r in ipairs(l.glowRects) do r.BackgroundColor3 = g end
			if l.badge.Visible then l.badge.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(34 + 4 * a, 34 + 4 * a) end
		end
	end)
end
local function stopPulse()

collected.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(gained, combo, layers, mult)
	combo, layers, mult = tonumber(combo) or 0, tonumber(layers) or 0, tonumber(mult) or 1
	-- MEGA DIG = a payout at least 4x your recent average, at most once every 10 s (2026-10-04 v2)
	local g = tonumber(gained) or 0
	local isMega = avgGain ~= nil and g >= avgGain * 4 and os.clock() - lastMega > 10
	avgGain = avgGain and (avgGain * 0.9 + g * 0.1) or g
	if isMega then lastMega = os.clock() end
	lastGain = os.clock()
	if os.clock() - lastCrunch > 0.14 then
		lastCrunch = os.clock()
		crunch.PlaybackSpeed = 0.8 + math.min(combo, COMBO_MAX) * 0.025 + math.random() * 0.06
		crunch:Play()
	end
	digBurst(0.4 + math.min(combo, COMBO_MAX) * 0.025)
	if combo >= 1 then
		local a, b = tierColors(combo)
		grad.Color = ColorSequence.new(a, b)
		comboText.Text = (combo >= COMBO_MAX and "MAX COMBO x%.2f" or "COMBO x%.2f"):format(mult)
		meter.Visible = true
		meterScale.Scale = 1.12
		TweenService:Create(meterScale, TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Scale = 1}):Play()
	end
	if isMega then
		showCallout("MEGA DIG!", Color3.fromRGB(255, 230, 120))
		bass:Play()
		local h = hrpPart()
		if h then pcall(VFX.Burst, h, "PowerUp", {Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 225, 120), Scale = 1}) end
	elseif combo >= COMBO_MAX and prevCombo < COMBO_MAX then
		showCallout("MAX COMBO! x2 SNOW", Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 230))
		shimmer:Play()
	elseif combo > prevCombo and combo % 5 == 0 and combo < COMBO_MAX then
		showCallout(("COMBO x%.2f!"):format(mult), Color3.fromRGB(255, 225, 120))
		shimmer:Play()
	end
	setMaxFx(combo >= COMBO_MAX)
	prevCombo = combo
end)

local function mk(class, props, parent)

-- A wheel face. GUI has no wedge shape, so every slice is filled with thin spokes: an invisible full-diameter arm turned around
-- the centre with its top half coloured (Roblox turns frames around their middle, which sits on the wheel's centre).
local function face(parent, step, labelled, z0)
	local rotor = frame(parent, {Name = "Rotor", BackgroundTransparency = 1, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), ZIndex = z0})
	local function arm(angle, width, color, name, z)
		local a = frame(rotor, {Name = name, BackgroundTransparency = 1, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromScale(width, 1), Rotation = angle, ZIndex = z})
		if color then frame(a, {BackgroundColor3 = color, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.5), ZIndex = z}) end
		return a
	end
	local width = math.sin(math.rad(step) / 2) * 1.3 -- a little wider than the gap between spokes at the rim
	for i, s in ipairs(W.Segments) do
		local a0 = (i - 1) * SEG
		local a = a0 + step / 2
		while a < a0 + SEG do arm(a, width, s.Color, "Spoke", z0); a += step end
	end
	for i = 0, N - 1 do arm(i * SEG, 0.014, WHITE, "Divider", z0 + 1) end
	local labels = {}
	if labelled then
		for i, s in ipairs(W.Segments) do
			local slot = arm((i - 0.5) * SEG, 0.3, nil, "Slice" .. i, z0 + 2)
			local icon = mk("ImageLabel", {Name = "Icon", BackgroundTransparency = 1, Image = SnowUI.Assets[s.Icon] or SnowUI.Assets.snow, ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
				AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.11), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.6, 0.12), ZIndex = z0 + 2}, nil)
			icon:SetAttribute("SnowUIDecor", true)
			icon.Parent = slot
			local main = text(slot, "", {Name = "Main", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.21), Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.075), ZIndex = z0 + 2}, 26)
			local sub = text(slot, "", {Name = "Sub", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.27), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.9, 0.045), ZIndex = z0 + 2}, 16, 1.5)
			labels[i] = {main = main, sub = sub}
		end
	end
	return rotor, labels
end

local CONFETTI = {Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 60), Color3.fromRGB(90, 255, 130), Color3.fromRGB(80, 190, 255), Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 170), Color3.fromRGB(190, 120, 255)}
local function confetti()

local function showResult(p)

	result.Visible = true

	resultScale.Scale = 0.6

local function spin()
	if spinning then return end
	if spins <= 0 then
		hint.Text = "Unlock a new stage to get a free spin!"
		return
	end
	spinning = true
	setSpins(spins)
	result.Visible = false
	local ok, res = pcall(function() return remote:InvokeServer("Spin") end)
	if not (ok and type(res) == "table" and res.Ok and res.Index) then
		spinning = false
		setSpins(type(res) == "table" and res.Spins or spins)
		if type(res) == "table" and res.Msg then hint.Text = res.Msg end
		return
	end
	-- land the chosen slice under the pointer: slice i's middle sits at (i - 0.5) * SEG degrees on the rotor
	local mid = (res.Index - 0.5) * SEG
	local jitter = (math.random() - 0.5) * SEG * 0.6
	local target = rotation - (rotation % 360) - mid + jitter
	while target < rotation + 360 * 5 do target += 360 end
	local tw = TweenService:Create(rotor, TweenInfo.new(W.SpinSeconds or 4.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Rotation = target})
	tw:Play()
	tw.Completed:Wait()
	rotation = target
	spinning = false
	showPrizes(res.Prizes)
	setSpins(player:GetAttribute("WheelSpins") or res.Spins)
	showResult(res.Prize)
	confetti()
end

local function smooth(x) x = math.clamp(x, 0, 1); return x * x * (3 - 2 * x) end
local function flat(v) return Vector3.new(v.X, 0, v.Z) end
local function unitFlat(v) local f = flat(v); if f.Magnitude < 1e-3 then return Vector3.new(0, 0, -1) end return f.Unit end
local function bounce(x)
	if x < 1 / 2.75 then return 7.5625 * x * x end
	if x < 2 / 2.75 then x -= 1.5 / 2.75; return 7.5625 * x * x + 0.75 end
	if x < 2.5 / 2.75 then x -= 2.25 / 2.75; return 7.5625 * x * x + 0.9375 end
	x -= 2.625 / 2.75
	return 7.5625 * x * x + 0.984375
end

local function far(pos)
	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	return (cam.CFrame.Position - (pos or (ev and ev.Center) or cam.CFrame.Position)).Magnitude > C.VFX.CullDistance
end
local function count(n) return settings.Reduced and math.max(1, math.ceil(n / 3)) or n end
local function anchor(pos, life, size)
	local p = mk("Part", {Name = "FKAnchor", Anchored = true, CanCollide = false, CanQuery = false, CanTouch = false, Transparency = 1,
		Size = size or Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2), CFrame = CFrame.new(pos)}, fxFolder)
	if life then Debris:AddItem(p, life) end
	return p
end
local function emitter(parent, props)
	local e = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	e.LightInfluence = 0.15
	for k, v in pairs(props) do e[k] = v end
	e.Parent = parent
	return e
end
local function puff(pos, color, n, size, speed)
	if far(pos) then return end
	local a = anchor(pos, 3)
	local e = emitter(a, {Texture = TX.smoke, Color = ColorSequence.new(color or WHITE), Size = NS(size or 2, (size or 2) * 2.2), Transparency = NS(0.25, 1),
		Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.6, 1.1), Speed = NumberRange.new(speed or 8, (speed or 8) * 1.6), SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 60),
		Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, 3, 0), Drag = 3, Rate = 0, RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(-60, 60), Rotation = NumberRange.new(0, 360)})
	e:Emit(count(n or 12))
end
local function paint(m, color, transp)
	for _, p in ipairs(m:GetDescendants()) do
		if p:IsA("BasePart") and p ~= m.PrimaryPart then p.Color = color; p.Material = Enum.Material.Neon; p.Transparency = transp; p.CastShadow = false end
	end
	return m
end
local function ringModel(pos, r, color, transp)
	local m = paint(Assets.TeleRing:Clone(), color, transp or 0.15)
	m.Parent = fxFolder
	m:ScaleTo(math.max(0.02, r / 10))
	m:PivotTo(CFrame.new(pos))
	return m
end
local function coneModel(origin, dir, range, color, transp)
	local m = paint(Assets.TeleCone:Clone(), color, transp)
	m.Parent = fxFolder
	m:ScaleTo(math.max(0.02, range / 10))
	m:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(origin, origin + dir))
	return m
end
local function tpart(props)
	local p = mk("Part", {Anchored = true, CanCollide = false, CanQuery = false, CanTouch = false, CastShadow = false, Material = Enum.Material.Neon,
		TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth, BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth}, nil)
	for k, v in pairs(props) do p[k] = v end
	p.Parent = fxFolder
	return p
end
local function disc(pos, r, color, transp)
	return tpart({Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder, Size = Vector3.new(0.12, r * 2, r * 2), CFrame = CFrame.new(pos) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)), Color = color, Transparency = transp or 0.55})
end
local function addTele(objs, expire, update) table.insert(tele, {objs = objs, expire = expire, update = update}) end
local function ringFade(pos, r0, r1, dur, color)
	if far(pos) then return end
	local m = ringModel(pos, r0, color or ICE, 0.1)
	local mp = m:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("MeshPart")
	local t0 = os.clock()
	local conn
	conn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		if not m.Parent then conn:Disconnect(); return end
		local k = math.min(1, (os.clock() - t0) / dur)
		m:ScaleTo(math.max(0.02, (r0 + (r1 - r0) * smooth(k)) / 10))
		m:PivotTo(CFrame.new(pos))
		if mp then mp.Transparency = 0.1 + 0.9 * k end
		if k >= 1 then conn:Disconnect(); m:Destroy() end
	end)
end
local SHARD = Assets.IceShard:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("MeshPart")
local function shards(pos, n, color)
	if far(pos) or not SHARD then return end
	for i = 1, count(n) do
		local s = SHARD:Clone()
		s.Anchored, s.CanCollide, s.CanQuery, s.CanTouch = true, false, false, false
		if color then s.Color = color end
		s.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos) * CFrame.Angles(math.random() * 6, math.random() * 6, math.random() * 6)
		s.Parent = fxFolder
		local dir = Vector3.new(math.random() - 0.5, 0.6 + math.random() * 0.6, math.random() - 0.5).Unit
		local goal = pos + dir * (5 + math.random() * 6)
		TweenService:Create(s, TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {CFrame = CFrame.new(goal) * CFrame.Angles(math.random() * 6, math.random() * 6, 0)}):Play()
		task.delay(0.5, function()
			if s.Parent then TweenService:Create(s, TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {CFrame = CFrame.new(goal.X, (ev and ev.SnowY) or (goal.Y - 4), goal.Z), Transparency = 1}):Play() end
		end)
		Debris:AddItem(s, 1.2)
	end
end

local function sound(name, at, pitch)
	local s = SOUNDS[name]
	if not s then return end
	local parent = at and anchor(at, 8) or gui
	local snd = mk("Sound", {SoundId = s[1], Volume = s[2], PlaybackSpeed = s[3] * (pitch or 1), RollOffMinDistance = 30, RollOffMaxDistance = 420}, parent)
	snd:Play()
	Debris:AddItem(snd, 8)
end
local function shake(power, dur)
	if not settings.Shake or not display.pos then return end
	if (workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position - display.pos).Magnitude > C.VFX.ShakeDistance then return end
	local hum = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not hum then return end
	task.spawn(function()
		local t0 = os.clock()
		while os.clock() - t0 < dur do
			local k = 1 - (os.clock() - t0) / dur
			hum.CameraOffset = Vector3.new((math.random() - 0.5) * power * k, (math.random() - 0.5) * power * k, 0)
			RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
		end
		hum.CameraOffset = Vector3.zero
	end)
end
local function gy(v) return Vector3.new(v.X, ev.SnowY + 0.15, v.Z) end
local function bossPos() return display.pos or (ev and ev.Center) or Vector3.zero end

local function buildModel()
	if model then model:Destroy() end
	model = Assets.FrostKing:Clone()
	rootPart = model.PrimaryPart
	local base = rootPart.CFrame
	parts, crownParts, flipperParts, beakPart = {}, {}, {}, nil
	partList, cfList = {}, {}
	for _, p in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
		if p:IsA("BasePart") and p ~= rootPart then
			local g = p:GetAttribute("Group") or "Body"
			table.insert(parts, {part = p, group = g, rel = base:ToObjectSpace(p.CFrame)})
			if g == "Crown" then table.insert(crownParts, p) end
			if p.Name == "HeadBeak" and not beakPart then beakPart = p end
			if (g == "FlipperL" or g == "FlipperR") and (not flipperParts[g] or p.Size.Magnitude > flipperParts[g].Size.Magnitude) then flipperParts[g] = p end
		end
	end
	for _, g in ipairs({"FlipperL", "FlipperR", "FootL", "FootR", "Head", "Crown"}) do joints[g] = model:GetAttribute("Joint_" .. g) or Vector3.zero end
	model.Parent = fxFolder
end
local function about(j, rx, ry, rz) return CFrame.new(j) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(rx), math.rad(ry), math.rad(rz)) * CFrame.new(-j) end
local function pose()
	local t = now()
	local pos, dir = display.pos, display.dir
	local lean, roll, lift, spin, twist = 0, 0, 0.3 * math.sin(t * 2.1), 0, 0
	local abdL, abdR = 10 + 6 * math.sin(t * 3), 10 + 6 * math.sin(t * 3 + 0.7)
	local swL, swR, hp, hy = 0, 0, 0, 0
	local state = st and st.State or "Arrival"
	local walking = display.speed > 0.8 and state == "Fight"
	if walking then roll = 5 * math.sin(t * 9); lift += math.abs(math.sin(t * 9)) * 0.4 end
	if ev and t < ev.FightAt then -- rise out of the portal during the last 3 seconds of the arrival
		local k = math.clamp((t - (ev.FightAt - 3)) / 3, 0, 1)
		lift = -26 * (1 - k) ^ 2 + 0.5 * math.sin(t * 30) * (1 - k)
	end
	local a = act
	if a and state == "Fight" then
		local u = t - a.T0
		local W, A, R = a.Windup, a.Active, a.Recover
		local k = a.Kind
		if k == "Slide" then
			if u < W then
				local s = smooth(u / W); lean = 16 * s; swL, swR = -40 * s, -40 * s; roll = math.sin(u * 30) * 1.5 * s
			elseif u < W + A then
				pos = a.Data.From:Lerp(a.Data.To, smooth((u - W) / A)); dir = unitFlat(a.Data.To - a.Data.From)
				lean = -80; lift = -1; swL, swR = -95, -95; abdL, abdR = 15, 15
			elseif u < W + A + R then
				local s = smooth((u - W - A) / R)
				pos = a.Data.To; dir = unitFlat(a.Data.To - a.Data.From); lean = -80 * (1 - s); swL, swR = -95 * (1 - s), -95 * (1 - s)
			end
		elseif k == "Barrage" then
			local s = smooth(math.min(1, u / math.max(0.01, W)))
			abdR = 10 + 140 * s; twist = -10 * s
			for _, b in ipairs(a.Data.Balls) do
				local e = t - b.Launch
				if e >= 0 and e < 0.25 then abdR = 150 - 110 * (e / 0.25); swR = 40 * (e / 0.25); twist = 12 end
			end
		elseif k == "Breath" then
			if u < W then
				local s = smooth(u / W); lean = 12 * s; hp = 25 * s; abdL, abdR = 10 + 35 * s, 10 + 35 * s; lift += 0.5 * s
			elseif u < W + A then
				lean = -8; hp = -12; roll = math.sin(u * 40) * 1.2; abdL, abdR = 40, 40
			elseif u < W + A + R then
				local s = smooth((u - W - A) / R); lean = -8 * (1 - s); hp = -12 * (1 - s)
			end
		elseif k == "Stomp" then
			local jump = a.Data.Jump or 0.6
			if u < W - jump then
				local s = smooth(u / math.max(0.01, W - jump)); lift = -1.2 * s; abdL, abdR = 10 + 40 * s, 10 + 40 * s
			elseif u < W then
				local s = (u - (W - jump)) / jump; lift = 13 * math.sin(math.pi * s); abdL, abdR = 150, 150
			elseif u < W + 0.35 then
				lift = -1.4 * (1 - (u - W) / 0.35); abdL, abdR = 30, 30
			end
		elseif k == "Spin" then
			if u < W then
				local s = smooth(u / W); abdL, abdR = 10 + 78 * s, 10 + 78 * s; lift = -0.6 * s; twist = math.sin(u * 20) * 4 * s
			elseif u < W + A then
				local e = u - W; spin = 900 * e * math.min(1, e / 0.3); abdL, abdR = 88, 88; lift = -0.6
			elseif u < W + A + R then
				local e = u - W - A; roll = 9 * math.sin(e * 6); hy = 18 * math.sin(e * 4); lean = 4 * math.sin(e * 5)
			end
		elseif k == "Stagger" then
			local s = math.min(1, u / math.max(0.01, A))
			roll = 7 * math.sin(u * 22) * (1 - s); lean = 14 * math.sin(s * math.pi); hp = 10 * math.sin(s * math.pi)
		end
	end
	local crownPop
	if state == "Defeat" then
		local u = t - (st.EndAt or t)
		lean = 95 * bounce(math.min(1, u / 1.1)); roll = 0; lift = 0
		abdL, abdR = 120 + 20 * math.sin(u * 14), 120 + 20 * math.sin(u * 14 + 1)
		crownPop = u
	elseif state == "Escape" then
		local u = t - (st.EndAt or t)
		lift = u < 0.5 and 6 * math.sin(math.pi * u / 0.5) or -28 * math.min(1, (u - 0.5) / 1.5)
	end
	local rootCF = CFrame.lookAt(pos, pos + dir) * CFrame.new(0, lift, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(twist), 0)
		* CFrame.new(0, 7, 0) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(lean), 0, math.rad(roll)) * CFrame.new(0, -7, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(spin), 0)
	local jl, jr = joints.FlipperL, joints.FlipperR
	local g = {
		FlipperL = about(jl, swL, 0, (jl.X >= 0 and 1 or -1) * abdL),
		FlipperR = about(jr, swR, 0, (jr.X >= 0 and 1 or -1) * abdR),
		Head = about(joints.Head, hp, hy, 0),
	}
	local stepA = walking and 14 * math.sin(t * 9) or 0
	g.FootL = about(joints.FootL, stepA, 0, 0)
	g.FootR = about(joints.FootR, -stepA, 0, 0)
	g.Crown = g.Head
	if crownPop then
		local u = math.min(crownPop, 1.1)
		g.Crown = g.Head * CFrame.new(0, 9 * u - 6 * u * u, 5 * u) * about(joints.Crown, u * 140, 0, u * 60)
	end
	rootPart.CFrame = rootCF
	for i, e in ipairs(parts) do
		partList[i] = e.part
		local gx = g[e.group]
		cfList[i] = gx and (rootCF * gx * e.rel) or (rootCF * e.rel)
	end
	workspace:BulkMoveTo(partList, cfList, Enum.BulkMoveMode.FireCFrameChanged)
end

local function telegraphCircle(pos, r, startT, endT)
	local p = gy(pos)
	local d = disc(p, r, DANGER, 0.6)
	local inner = disc(p + Vector3.new(0, 0.03, 0), 0.2, WARN, 0.3)
	local ring = ringModel(p + Vector3.new(0, 0.06, 0), r, WHITE, 0.1)
	addTele({d, inner, ring}, endT, function(t)
		local k = math.clamp((t - startT) / math.max(0.05, endT - startT), 0, 1)
		inner.Size = Vector3.new(0.12, 2 * r * k, 2 * r * k)
		d.Transparency = 0.5 + 0.15 * math.sin(t * 12)
	end)
end
local function telegraphLane(from, to, width, endT)
	local a, b = gy(from), gy(to)
	local len = math.max(1, (b - a).Magnitude)
	local cf = CFrame.lookAt((a + b) / 2, b)
	local body = tpart({Size = Vector3.new(width, 0.12, len), CFrame = cf, Color = DANGER, Transparency = 0.6})
	local e1 = tpart({Size = Vector3.new(0.45, 0.14, len), CFrame = cf * CFrame.new(width / 2, 0.02, 0), Color = WHITE, Transparency = 0.1})
	local e2 = tpart({Size = Vector3.new(0.45, 0.14, len), CFrame = cf * CFrame.new(-width / 2, 0.02, 0), Color = WHITE, Transparency = 0.1})
	local objs = {body, e1, e2}
	local dv = (b - a).Unit
	for i = 1, 3 do table.insert(objs, coneModel(a + dv * (len * i / 4) + Vector3.new(0, 0.05, 0), dv, 3.5, WHITE, 0.2)) end
	addTele(objs, endT, function(t) body.Transparency = 0.5 + 0.15 * math.sin(t * 14) end)
end
local function telegraphCone(origin, dir, range, endT)
	local m = coneModel(gy(origin), dir, range, DANGER, 0.55)
	local mp = m:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("MeshPart")
	addTele({m}, endT, function(t) if mp then mp.Transparency = 0.45 + 0.15 * math.sin(t * 12) end end)
end
local function telegraphStomp(d, endT)
	local c = gy(d.Center)
	local zone = disc(c, d.MaxRadius, WARN, 0.88)
	local slam = disc(c + Vector3.new(0, 0.02, 0), C.Boss.Radius + 2.5, DANGER, 0.55)
	local objs = {zone, slam}
	local rings = {}
	for i, rs in ipairs(d.Rings) do
		local m = ringModel(c + Vector3.new(0, -60, 0), d.Start, ICE, 0.05)
		rings[i] = {m = m, rs = rs}
		table.insert(objs, m)
	end
	addTele(objs, endT, function(t)
		slam.Transparency = t < d.Rings[1] and (0.45 + 0.15 * math.sin(t * 16)) or 1
		for _, r in ipairs(rings) do
			local e = t - r.rs
			local rad = d.Start + d.Speed * e
			if e >= 0 and rad <= d.MaxRadius then
				r.m:ScaleTo(math.max(0.02, rad / 10))
				r.m:PivotTo(CFrame.new(c + Vector3.new(0, 0.12, 0)))
			else
				r.m:PivotTo(CFrame.new(c + Vector3.new(0, -60, 0)))
			end
		end
	end)
end

local function trailOn(part, offA, offB, life, color)
	local a0 = mk("Attachment", {Position = offA}, part)
	local a1 = mk("Attachment", {Position = offB}, part)
	local tr = mk("Trail", {Attachment0 = a0, Attachment1 = a1, Lifetime = life, Color = ColorSequence.new(color or WHITE), Transparency = NS(0.15, 1),
		LightEmission = 0.5, FaceCamera = true, WidthScale = NS(1, 0.2)}, part)
	return function() tr.Enabled = false; Debris:AddItem(tr, life + 0.1); Debris:AddItem(a0, life + 0.1); Debris:AddItem(a1, life + 0.1) end
end
local function impactFX(pos, big)
	sound("Impact", pos, big and 0.7 or 1)
	if far(pos) then return end
	pcall(VFX.Burst, anchor(pos, 3), "Impact", {Color = WHITE, Scale = big and 2.6 or 1.3})
	puff(pos, WHITE, big and 22 or 12, big and 3 or 2, big and 14 or 8)
	ringFade(pos + Vector3.new(0, 0.2, 0), 1, big and 14 or 7, big and 0.7 or 0.5, ICE)
	shards(pos, big and 6 or 4)
end
local function throwBall(b)
	if not ev then return end
	local from = bossPos() + Vector3.new(0, 16, 0)
	local to = gy(b.Target) + Vector3.new(0, 0.6, 0)
	local ball = Assets.Snowball:Clone()
	ball.Parent = fxFolder
	local main = ball.PrimaryPart
	if not settings.Reduced then
		local a0 = mk("Attachment", {Position = Vector3.new(0, 1.3, 0)}, main)
		local a1 = mk("Attachment", {Position = Vector3.new(0, -1.3, 0)}, main)
		mk("Trail", {Attachment0 = a0, Attachment1 = a1, Lifetime = 0.35, Color = ColorSequence.new(WHITE, ICE), Transparency = NS(0.2, 1), LightEmission = 0.4, FaceCamera = true}, main)
	end
	sound("Throw", from)
	local dur = math.max(0.2, b.Land - now())
	local t0 = os.clock()
	local conn
	conn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		if not ball.Parent then conn:Disconnect(); return end
		local k = math.min(1, (os.clock() - t0) / dur)
		ball:PivotTo(CFrame.new(from:Lerp(to, k) + Vector3.new(0, math.sin(math.pi * k) * 14, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(k * 9, k * 6, 0))
		if k >= 1 then conn:Disconnect(); ball:Destroy(); impactFX(to, false) end
	end)
end
local function breathFX(a)
	if not ev then return end
	sound("Breath", bossPos())
	local dir = a.Data.Dir
	local o = beakPart and (beakPart.Position + dir * 1.5) or (gy(a.Data.Origin) + Vector3.new(0, 13, 0))
	local base = anchor(o, a.Active + 1.5)
	base.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(o, o + dir + Vector3.new(0, -0.35, 0))
	local att = mk("Attachment", {}, base)
	local e1 = emitter(att, {Texture = TX.streak, EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Front, Color = ColorSequence.new(WHITE, ICE), Size = NS(2, 4.5), Transparency = NS(0.15, 1),
		Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.55, 0.8), Speed = NumberRange.new(40, 55), SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(26, 12), Rate = settings.Reduced and 30 or 90, LightEmission = 0.8})
	local e2 = emitter(att, {Texture = TX.star, EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Front, Color = ColorSequence.new(WHITE), Size = NS(0.6, 0.2), Transparency = NS(0, 1),
		Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.6, 1.0), Speed = NumberRange.new(30, 45), SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(30, 15), Rate = settings.Reduced and 15 or 50,
		RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(-120, 120), LightEmission = 1})
	local beams = {}
	if not settings.Reduced then
		for i = -1, 1 do
			local endPos = gy(a.Data.Origin) + (CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(i * 18), 0) * dir) * a.Data.Range + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0)
			local target = anchor(endPos, a.Active + 1.5)
			local b0 = mk("Attachment", {}, base)
			local b1 = mk("Attachment", {}, target)
			table.insert(beams, mk("Beam", {Attachment0 = b0, Attachment1 = b1, Texture = TX.streak, TextureSpeed = 2.5, TextureLength = 6, TextureMode = Enum.TextureMode.Wrap,
				Width0 = 2.5, Width1 = 9, CurveSize0 = 6 * i, CurveSize1 = -4 * i, Color = ColorSequence.new(ICE), Transparency = NS(0.35, 0.85), LightEmission = 0.7, FaceCamera = true}, base))
		end
	end
	task.delay(a.Active, function() e1.Enabled = false; e2.Enabled = false; for _, b in ipairs(beams) do b.Enabled = false end end)
end
local function patchesFX(a)
	for _, p in ipairs(a.Data.Patches) do
		local d = disc(gy(p), a.Data.PatchRadius, Color3.fromRGB(175, 230, 255), 0.35)
		d.Material = Enum.Material.Ice
		if not settings.Reduced then
			emitter(d, {Texture = TX.star, Color = ColorSequence.new(WHITE), Size = NS(0.5, 0), Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.6, 1.2), Speed = NumberRange.new(1, 3), Rate = 6, LightEmission = 1})
		end
		local untilT = now() + a.Data.PatchSeconds
		addTele({d}, untilT, function(t) local left = untilT - t; d.Transparency = left < 1 and (0.35 + 0.65 * (1 - left)) or 0.35 end)
	end
end
local function spinFX(a)
	sound("Spin", bossPos())
	local stops = {}
	for _, g in ipairs({"FlipperL", "FlipperR"}) do
		local fp = flipperParts[g]
		if fp then
			local s = fp.Size
			local axis = (s.Y >= s.X and s.Y >= s.Z) and Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) or ((s.X >= s.Z) and Vector3.new(1, 0, 0) or Vector3.new(0, 0, 1))
			local long = math.max(s.X, s.Y, s.Z)
			table.insert(stops, trailOn(fp, axis * long * 0.45, axis * long * 0.1, 0.45, ICE))
		end
	end
	local base = rootPart and mk("Attachment", {Position = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)}, rootPart)
	local swirl = base and emitter(base, {Texture = TX.smoke, Color = ColorSequence.new(WHITE), Size = NS(2, 4), Transparency = NS(0.3, 1), Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.5, 0.8),
		Speed = NumberRange.new(14, 22), SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 10), Rate = settings.Reduced and 20 or 60, Drag = 3}) or nil
	task.delay(a.Active, function()
		for _, f in ipairs(stops) do f() end
		if swirl then swirl.Enabled = false end
		if base then Debris:AddItem(base, 1.2) end
	end)
end
local function dizzyFX(a)
	if not rootPart then return end
	local att = mk("Attachment", {Position = Vector3.new(0, 23, 0)}, rootPart)
	local e = emitter(att, {Texture = TX.star, Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 240, 140)), Size = NS(1.2, 0.6), Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.8, 1.2),
		Speed = NumberRange.new(2, 4), SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 20), Rate = 10, RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(-200, 200), LightEmission = 1})
	task.delay(a.Recover, function() e.Enabled = false; Debris:AddItem(att, 1.3) end)
end
local function staggerFX()
	sound("Phase", bossPos(), 1.1)
	if crownParts[1] then
		local l = mk("PointLight", {Color = ICE, Range = 24, Brightness = 5}, crownParts[1])
		TweenService:Create(l, TweenInfo.new(1.6), {Brightness = 0}):Play()
		Debris:AddItem(l, 1.7)
	end
	puff(bossPos() + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0), WHITE, 16, 3, 10)
end
local function finalAura()
	if aura or not rootPart then return end
	local ok, h = pcall(VFX.Attach, rootPart, "IceAura", {Color = ICE, Scale = 3})
	aura = ok and h or true
	if crownParts[1] then mk("PointLight", {Color = Color3.fromRGB(170, 140, 255), Range = 26, Brightness = 3}, crownParts[1]) end
	for _, p in ipairs(crownParts) do if p.Material == Enum.Material.Neon then p.Color = Color3.fromRGB(190, 150, 255) end end
end
local function at(a, sec, fn) task.delay(math.max(0, a.T0 + sec - now()), function() if act == a then fn() end end) end
local function onAction(a)
	act = a
	if not ev then return end
	local k = a.Kind
	local endT = a.T0 + a.Windup + a.Active
	if k == "Slide" then
		telegraphLane(a.Data.From, a.Data.To, a.Data.Width, endT)
		sound("Roar", bossPos(), 1.15)
		at(a, a.Windup, function()
			sound("Slide", bossPos())
			if not rootPart then return end
			local stops = {trailOn(rootPart, Vector3.new(4.5, 0.5, 0), Vector3.new(4.5, 2, 0), 1.6, WHITE), trailOn(rootPart, Vector3.new(-4.5, 0.5, 0), Vector3.new(-4.5, 2, 0), 1.6, WHITE)}
			local att = mk("Attachment", {Position = Vector3.new(0, 1, -6)}, rootPart)
			local spray = emitter(att, {Texture = TX.smoke, Color = ColorSequence.new(WHITE), Size = NS(2.5, 5), Transparency = NS(0.2, 1), Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.5, 0.9),
				Speed = NumberRange.new(10, 18), SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(50, 30), EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Top, Rate = settings.Reduced and 25 or 70, Drag = 2})
			local streak = (not settings.Reduced) and emitter(att, {Texture = TX.streak, Color = ColorSequence.new(ICE), Size = NS(1.2, 0.2), Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.3, 0.5),
				Speed = NumberRange.new(25, 35), SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(30, 10), EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Back, Rate = 40, LightEmission = 1}) or nil
			task.delay(a.Active, function()
				for _, f in ipairs(stops) do f() end
				spray.Enabled = false
				if streak then streak.Enabled = false end
				Debris:AddItem(att, 1.2)
				if ev then puff(gy(a.Data.To), WHITE, 18, 3, 12) end
			end)
		end)
	elseif k == "Barrage" then
		for _, b in ipairs(a.Data.Balls) do
			telegraphCircle(b.Target, a.Data.Radius, a.T0, b.Land)
			at(a, b.Launch - a.T0, function() throwBall(b) end)
		end
	elseif k == "Breath" then
		telegraphCone(a.Data.Origin, a.Data.Dir, a.Data.Range, endT)
		sound("Inhale", bossPos())
		at(a, a.Windup, function() breathFX(a) end)
		at(a, a.Windup + a.Active, function() patchesFX(a) end)
	elseif k == "Stomp" then
		telegraphStomp(a.Data, endT)
		at(a, a.Windup, function()
			sound("Stomp", gy(a.Data.Center))
			impactFX(gy(a.Data.Center), true)
			shake(1.2, 0.35)
		end)
		if a.Data.Rings[2] then at(a, a.Data.Rings[2] - a.T0, function() sound("Stomp", gy(a.Data.Center), 1.15); puff(gy(a.Data.Center), WHITE, 14, 3, 12) end) end
	elseif k == "Spin" then
		local r = a.Data.Radius
		local d = disc(gy(bossPos()), r, DANGER, 0.6)
		local ring = ringModel(gy(bossPos()) + Vector3.new(0, 0.06, 0), r, WHITE, 0.1)
		addTele({d, ring}, endT, function(t)
			local p = gy(bossPos())
			d.CFrame = CFrame.new(p) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
			ring:PivotTo(CFrame.new(p + Vector3.new(0, 0.06, 0)))
			d.Transparency = 0.5 + 0.15 * math.sin(t * 14)
		end)
		at(a, a.Windup, function() spinFX(a) end)
		at(a, a.Windup + a.Active, function() dizzyFX(a) end)
	elseif k == "Stagger" then
		staggerFX()
	end
end

local function arrivalFX(s)
	local c = Vector3.new(s.Center.X, s.SnowY, s.Center.Z)
	local portal = Assets.IcePortal:Clone()
	portal.Parent = fxFolder
	local base = CFrame.new(c + Vector3.new(0, 0.1, 0))
	portal:PivotTo(base)
	local spinConn
	spinConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		if not portal.Parent then spinConn:Disconnect(); return end
		portal:PivotTo(base * CFrame.Angles(0, (os.clock() * 0.6) % (2 * math.pi), 0))
	end)
	local pad = anchor(c + Vector3.new(0, 0.3, 0), nil, Vector3.new(16, 0.2, 16))
	local att = mk("Attachment", {}, pad)
	emitter(att, {Texture = TX["rune-circle"], Orientation = Enum.ParticleOrientation.VelocityPerpendicular, EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Top, Speed = NumberRange.new(0.01),
		Size = NS(17, 17), Lifetime = NumberRange.new(2, 2.4), Rate = settings.Reduced and 0.8 or 1.6, RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(40, 60), Rotation = NumberRange.new(0, 360),
		LightEmission = 1, Color = ColorSequence.new(ICE), Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.3, 0.35), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1)})})
	emitter(pad, {Texture = TX.smoke, Color = ColorSequence.new(WHITE), Size = NS(1.6, 3.5), Transparency = NS(0.4, 1), Lifetime = NumberRange.new(1.2, 2),
		Speed = NumberRange.new(4, 8), EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Top, SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(15, 15), Rate = settings.Reduced and 6 or 18, Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)})
	emitter(pad, {Texture = TX.star, Color = ColorSequence.new(WHITE, ICE), Size = NS(0.6, 0), Lifetime = NumberRange.new(1.5, 2.5), Speed = NumberRange.new(6, 12),
		EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Top, SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(20, 20), Rate = settings.Reduced and 8 or 26, LightEmission = 1})
	local pillar = tpart({Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder, Size = Vector3.new(1, 5, 5), CFrame = CFrame.new(c + Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)), Color = ICE, Transparency = 0.65})
	local light = mk("PointLight", {Color = ICE, Range = 40, Brightness = 2}, pillar)
	local s0, dur = os.clock(), math.max(1, s.FightAt - now())
	local conn
	conn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		if not pillar.Parent then conn:Disconnect(); return end
		local k = math.min(1, (os.clock() - s0) / dur)
		local h = 2 + 46 * k
		pillar.Size = Vector3.new(h, 5 + 3 * k, 5 + 3 * k)
		pillar.CFrame = CFrame.new(c + Vector3.new(0, h / 2, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
		light.Brightness = 1 + 3 * k
	end)
	task.spawn(function()
		while ev and ev.Id == s.Id and now() < s.FightAt do
			ringFade(c + Vector3.new(0, 0.25, 0), 3, 20, 1.4, ICE)
			task.wait(settings.Reduced and 3 or 1.8)
		end
	end)
	task.delay(math.max(0, s.FightAt - 3 - now()), function()
		if not ev or ev.Id ~= s.Id then return end
		sound("Roar", c)
		shake(0.8, 2.6)
		puff(c, WHITE, 30, 4, 16)
	end)
	task.delay(math.max(0, s.FightAt - now()) + 0.3, function()
		if not ev or ev.Id ~= s.Id then return end
		ringFade(c + Vector3.new(0, 0.3, 0), 4, 32, 1.1, WHITE)
		pcall(VFX.Burst, anchor(c + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0), 3), "PowerUp", {Color = ICE, Scale = 2.4})
		if pillar.Parent then pillar:Destroy() end
		if pad.Parent then pad:Destroy() end
		for _, p in ipairs(portal:GetDescendants()) do if p:IsA("BasePart") then TweenService:Create(p, TweenInfo.new(1.2), {Transparency = 1}):Play() end end
		Debris:AddItem(portal, 1.4)
	end)
end
local function makeMarker(s)

	local bb = mk("BillboardGui", {Name = "FrostKingMarker", Size = UDim2.fromOffset(250, 70), AlwaysOnTop = false, LightInfluence = 0, MaxDistance = 100000, Adornee = markerPart}, markerPart)

end
local function defeatFX()
	sound("Victory")
	showMsg("\u{1F3C6} THE FROST KING IS DEFEATED!", Color3.fromRGB(255, 232, 150), 3)
	task.delay(1.1, function()
		if not model or not display.pos or not ev then return end
		local cpos = crownParts[1] and crownParts[1].Position or (display.pos + Vector3.new(0, 20, 0))
		for _, p in ipairs(crownParts) do p.Transparency = 1 end
		shards(cpos, 10, Color3.fromRGB(190, 240, 255))
		pcall(VFX.Burst, anchor(cpos, 3), "PowerUp", {Color = ICE, Scale = 2.6})
		ringFade(gy(display.pos) + Vector3.new(0, 0.3, 0), 2, 28, 1.2, ICE)
		puff(display.pos + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0), WHITE, 26, 4, 16)
		shake(1.2, 0.4)
		sound("Impact", cpos, 1.4)
	end)
	task.delay(3.4, function()
		if not model then return end
		for _, e in ipairs(parts) do TweenService:Create(e.part, TweenInfo.new(1.2), {Transparency = 1}):Play() end
	end)
end
local function escapeFX()
	sound("Escape")
	showMsg("\u{2744} The Frost King escaped...", ICE, 3)
	if display.pos and ev then puff(display.pos, WHITE, 24, 4, 12); ringFade(gy(display.pos) + Vector3.new(0, 0.3, 0), 2, 20, 1.2, ICE) end
end

local function busy()
	if player:GetAttribute("IntroActive") or player:GetAttribute("IntroPlaying") then return true end
	local pg = player:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
	local rd = pg and pg:FindFirstChild("RareDropGui")
	if rd and rd.Enabled then return true end
	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local blur = cam and cam:FindFirstChild("HatchBlur")
	if blur and blur.Enabled and blur.Size > 1 then return true end
	return false
end
local function canJoinLocal()
	if not ev then return false end
	if ev.Style == "Starter" then return ev.World ~= 2 end
	return player:GetAttribute("Stage_" .. ev.Style) == true
end
local function refreshJoin()
	local ok = canJoinLocal()
	for _, pair in ipairs({{joinBtn, joinText}, {pillJoin, pillJoinText}}) do
		pair[1].BackgroundColor3 = ok and GREEN or GREY
		pair[2].Text = ok and "JOIN" or "\u{1F512} LOCKED"
	end
	return ok
end
local function showAnnouncement()
	if not ev or dismissed then return end
	local ok = refreshJoin()
	annSub.Text = ok and ("Giant Penguin spotted in %s!"):format(ev.Name) or ("Giant Penguin spotted in %s! (unlock it to join)"):format(ev.Name)
	ann.Visible = true
	annScale.Scale = 0.55
	TweenService:Create(annScale, TweenInfo.new(0.45, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Scale = 1}):Play()
	sound("Arrive")
	task.delay(0.35, function() sound("Sting") end)
	local my = ev.Id
	task.delay(14, function() if ev and ev.Id == my then ann.Visible = false end end)
end
local function queueAnnouncement()
	local my = ev.Id
	task.spawn(function()
		local waited = 0
		while ev and ev.Id == my and busy() and waited < 90 do task.wait(0.5); waited += 0.5 end
		if ev and ev.Id == my and st and (st.State == "Arrival" or st.State == "Fight") then showAnnouncement() end
	end)
end
local joining = false
local function doJoin()
	if not ev or joining then return end
	if not canJoinLocal() then showMsg(("Unlock %s to join!"):format(ev.Name), WARN, 2.5) return end
	joining = true
	local ok, res, text = pcall(function() return joinFn:InvokeServer("Join") end)
	joining = false
	if ok and res then ann.Visible = false; showMsg("\u{2744} To battle!", ICE, 1.6) else showMsg(tostring((ok and text) or "Couldn't join right now."), WARN, 2.5) end
end
joinBtn.Activated:Connect(doJoin)
pillJoin.Activated:Connect(doJoin)
laterBtn.Activated:Connect(function() ann.Visible = false; dismissed = true end)
rewardOk.Activated:Connect(function() rewardPanel.Visible = false end)
local function refreshToggles()
	fxText.Text = settings.Reduced and "FX LOW" or "FX"
	shakeText.Text = settings.Shake and "SHAKE" or "NO SHAKE"

fxBtn.Activated:Connect(function() settings.Reduced = not settings.Reduced; refreshToggles() end)
