local function cleanupAll()
	for _, e in ipairs(tele) do for _, o in ipairs(e.objs) do if o and o.Parent then o:Destroy() end end end
	tele = {}
	fxFolder:ClearAllChildren()
	model, rootPart, beakPart, markerPart, markerText, aura = nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil
	parts, crownParts, flipperParts, partList, cfList = {}, {}, {}, {}, {}
	ann.Visible, pill.Visible, bar.Visible, mePanel.Visible, hint.Visible = false, false, false, false, false
	act, me, ev, st, lastState = nil, nil, nil, nil, nil
	display.pos = nil
end
local function onSpawn(s)
	cleanupAll()
	ev = s
	dismissed = false
	st = {State = "Arrival", Pos = s.Center, Facing = unitFlat(s.Entry - s.Center), Phase = 1, HP = 1, MaxHP = 1, Ends = s.Ends}
	lastState = "Arrival"
	buildModel()
	if now() < s.FightAt then arrivalFX(s) end
	makeMarker(s)
	queueAnnouncement()
end
local function onState(s)
	if not ev then return end
	st = s
	if s.State ~= lastState then
		local prev = lastState
		lastState = s.State
		if s.State == "Defeat" then act = nil; defeatFX()
		elseif s.State == "Escape" then act = nil; escapeFX()
		elseif s.State == "Fight" and prev == "Arrival" then showMsg("\u{2744} THE FROST KING ATTACKS!", ICE, 2) end
	end
	if (s.Phase or 1) >= 3 and s.State == "Fight" then finalAura() end
end
local knockToken = 0
local function onReward(r)
	local lines = {}
	if r.Qualified then
		table.insert(lines, ("+%s \u{2744} Snow"):format(Format.Abbreviate(r.Snow or 0)))
		if r.Treasure then table.insert(lines, "\u{1F48E} Treasure: " .. tostring(r.Treasure)) end
		if r.Boost then
			local nm = r.Boost == "Snow2" and "2x Snow" or (r.Boost == "Luck2" and "2x Luck" or tostring(r.Boost))
			table.insert(lines, ("\u{26A1} %s for %d min"):format(nm, math.floor((r.BoostSeconds or 0) / 60)))
		end
	else
		table.insert(lines, ("Fight longer next time to earn rewards!\n(%d/%d s near the boss, %d/%d s hitting it)"):format(r.Engaged or 0, r.NeedEngaged or 0, r.Hit or 0, r.NeedHit or 0))
	end
	rewardTitle.Text = r.Result == "Victory" and "\u{1F3C6} VICTORY!" or "\u{2744} IT ESCAPED"
	rewardTitle.TextColor3 = r.Result == "Victory" and Color3.fromRGB(255, 232, 150) or ICE
	rewardLines.Text = table.concat(lines, "\n")
	rewardPanel.Visible = true
	rewardScale.Scale = 0.5
	TweenService:Create(rewardScale, TweenInfo.new(0.45, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Scale = 1}):Play()
	if r.Qualified and r.Result == "Victory" then
		local hrp = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if hrp then pcall(VFX.Burst, hrp, "PowerUp", {Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 225, 120), Scale = 1.4}) end
	end
	task.delay(9, function() rewardPanel.Visible = false end)
end
event.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(m)
	if type(m) ~= "table" then return end
	local kind = m.T
	if kind == "Spawn" then
		onSpawn(m)
	elseif kind == "State" then
		onState(m)
	elseif kind == "Action" then
		if ev then onAction(m) end
	elseif kind == "Phase" then
		sound("Phase", display.pos)
		showMsg(m.Phase >= 3 and "\u{2744} FINAL PHASE! \u{2744}" or "PHASE II - it's getting angry!", m.Phase >= 3 and Color3.fromRGB(210, 170, 255) or ICE, 2.2)
		if m.Phase >= 3 then finalAura() end
	elseif kind == "Hit" then
		if m.Frost then flash(ICE, 0.82) else flash(DANGER, 0.55); sound("Hurt"); shake(0.5, 0.2) end
		local hrp = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if hrp and m.Push then hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity * 0.3 + m.Push end
		if me then me.HP = m.HP end
	elseif kind == "Knocked" then
		knockToken += 1
		local my, untilT = knockToken, m.Until
		task.spawn(function()
			while knockToken == my and now() < untilT do
				showMsg(("KNOCKED OUT! Back in %d..."):format(math.ceil(untilT - now())), WARN, 1.1)
				task.wait(1)
			end
		end)
	elseif kind == "Recovered" then
		knockToken += 1
		showMsg("\u{2744} Back in the fight!", ICE, 1.5)
	elseif kind == "Me" then
		me = m
	elseif kind == "Reward" then
		onReward(m.Reward or {})
	elseif kind == "Cleanup" then
		cleanupAll()
	end
end)
task.spawn(function()
	local ok, snap = pcall(function() return joinFn:InvokeServer("Sync") end)
	if ok and type(snap) == "table" and snap.Spawn then
		onSpawn(snap.Spawn)
		if snap.State then onState(snap.State) end
		if snap.Action then onAction(snap.Action) end
	end
end)

local function hud()
	local t = now()
	local hrp = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local pd = hrp and flat(hrp.Position - ev.Center).Magnitude or math.huge
	local near = pd < math.max(ev.W, ev.D) * 0.7 + 25
	local state = st and st.State or "Arrival"
	local live = state == "Arrival" or state == "Fight"
	if ann.Visible then
		annTime.Text = state == "Arrival" and ("Battle starts in " .. fmtTime(ev.FightAt - t)) or ("Battle in progress \u{2022} " .. fmtTime((st.Ends or t) - t) .. " left")
	end
	pill.Visible = live and not ann.Visible and not near
	if pill.Visible then
		pillText.Text = ("\u{2744} FROST KING \u{2022} %s"):format(state == "Arrival" and fmtTime(ev.FightAt - t) or fmtTime((st.Ends or t) - t))
	end
	bar.Visible = (near or me ~= nil) and (live or state == "Defeat")
	if bar.Visible and st then
		local f = math.clamp((st.HP or 0) / math.max(1, st.MaxHP or 1), 0, 1)
		fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(state == "Arrival" and 1 or f, 1)
		hpText.Text = state == "Arrival" and "ARRIVING..." or ("%d%%"):format(math.ceil(f * 100))
		local ph = st.Phase or 1
		barPhase.Text = ph >= 3 and "FINAL PHASE" or (ph == 2 and "PHASE II" or "PHASE I")
		barPhase.TextColor3 = ph >= 3 and Color3.fromRGB(210, 170, 255) or ICE
		barTime.Text = state == "Arrival" and fmtTime(ev.FightAt - t) or fmtTime((st.Ends or t) - t)
		fillGrad.Color = ph >= 3 and ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(205, 150, 255), Color3.fromRGB(125, 70, 255)) or ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(120, 220, 255), Color3.fromRGB(60, 140, 255))
	end
	mePanel.Visible = me ~= nil and live
	if mePanel.Visible then
		local hpv = math.max(0, me.HP or 0)
		meHPFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(math.clamp(hpv / (me.MaxHP or 100), 0, 1), 1)
		meHPText.Text = ("\u{2764} %d / %d"):format(math.ceil(hpv), me.MaxHP or 100)
		mePart.Text = me.Qualified and "\u{2714} Qualified for rewards!" or ("Fight %d/%ds \u{2022} Hit %d/%ds"):format(math.floor(me.Engaged or 0), me.NeedEngaged or 0, math.floor(me.Hit or 0), me.NeedHit or 0)
		mePart.TextColor3 = me.Qualified and Color3.fromRGB(160, 255, 170) or WHITE
		meReward.Text = ("Reward \u{2248} %s \u{2744}"):format(Format.Abbreviate(me.Reward or 0))
	end
	if markerPart then
		markerPart.Parent = live and fxFolder or nil
		if markerText then markerText.Text = ("\u{2744} FROST KING\n%s"):format(pd < 1e6 and (math.floor(pd) .. " studs") or ev.Name) end
	end
	local show = false
	if act and act.Kind == "Stomp" and hrp and state == "Fight" then
		local d = flat(hrp.Position - act.Data.Center).Magnitude
		for _, rs in ipairs(act.Data.Rings) do
			local rad = act.Data.Start + act.Data.Speed * (t - rs)
			if t >= rs - 0.6 and d <= act.Data.MaxRadius + 1 and d > rad - 1 and (d - rad) / act.Data.Speed < 0.8 then show = true end
		end
	end
	hint.Visible = show
end
local hudAcc = 0
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
	if not ev then return end
	if st and st.Pos then
		if not display.pos then display.pos = st.Pos; display.dir = unitFlat(st.Facing or display.dir) end
		local prev = display.pos
		display.pos = display.pos:Lerp(st.Pos, 1 - math.exp(-dt * 6))
		display.dir = unitFlat(display.dir:Lerp(unitFlat(st.Facing or display.dir), 1 - math.exp(-dt * 5)))
		display.speed = flat(display.pos - prev).Magnitude / math.max(dt, 1e-3)
	end
	if model and rootPart and display.pos then pcall(pose) end
	local t = now()
	for i = #tele, 1, -1 do
		local e = tele[i]
		if t >= e.expire then
			for _, o in ipairs(e.objs) do if o and o.Parent then o:Destroy() end end
			table.remove(tele, i)
		elseif e.update then
			pcall(e.update, t)
		end
	end
	hudAcc += dt
	if hudAcc >= 0.1 then hudAcc = 0; pcall(hud) end
end)

-- PetFollow: every player's equipped pets hop along behind them (built & animated locally).
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local PetModels = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("PetModels"))

local BEHIND = 7.5        -- distance behind the player (outside the shovel spinner)
local SPACING = 3.4       -- side-by-side spacing
local VIEW_DISTANCE = 200

local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
folder.Name = "FollowingPets"
folder.Parent = workspace

local rigs = {}
local function clear(player)
	local r = rigs[player]
	if r then for _, p in ipairs(r) do p.model:Destroy() end end
	rigs[player] = nil
end
local function build(player)
	clear(player)
	local r = {}
	for name in (player:GetAttribute("EquippedPets") or ""):gmatch("[^,]+") do
		local m = PetModels.create(name)
		local _, size = m:GetBoundingBox()
		m.Parent = folder
		table.insert(r, {model = m, half = size.Y / 2, cf = nil})
	end
	rigs[player] = r
end
local function track(player)
	player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("EquippedPets"):Connect(function() build(player) end)
	build(player)
end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(track)
for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do task.spawn(track, p) end
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(clear)

local params = RaycastParams.new()
params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

local t = 0
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
	t += dt
	local camPos = workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position
	for player, r in pairs(rigs) do
		local char = player.Character
		local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local visible = hrp and (hrp.Position - camPos).Magnitude < VIEW_DISTANCE and not (player == Players.LocalPlayer and player:GetAttribute("IntroPlaying"))
		local moving = hum and hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.1
		local n = #r
		for i, p in ipairs(r) do
			if not visible then
				p.model.Parent = nil
				p.cf = nil
			else
				if p.model.Parent ~= folder then p.model.Parent = folder end
				local look = Vector3.new(hrp.CFrame.LookVector.X, 0, hrp.CFrame.LookVector.Z).Unit
				local right = Vector3.new(-look.Z, 0, look.X)
				local side = (i - (n + 1) / 2) * SPACING
				local target = hrp.Position - look * (BEHIND + math.abs(side) * 0.3) + right * side
				-- stand on the ground
				params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {char, folder}
				local hit = workspace:Raycast(target + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0), Vector3.new(0, -14, 0), params)
				local groundY = hit and hit.Position.Y or (hrp.Position.Y - 3)
				local hop = moving and math.abs(math.sin(t * 9 + i)) * 0.9 or math.sin(t * 2 + i) * 0.15
				local pos = Vector3.new(target.X, groundY + p.half + hop, target.Z)
				local goal = CFrame.lookAt(pos, pos + look)
				p.cf = p.cf and p.cf:Lerp(goal, 1 - math.exp(-dt * 10)) or goal
				p.model:PivotTo(p.cf)
			end
		end
	end
end)

	return player:GetAttribute("MusicDuck") and cfg.DuckVolume or cfg.Volume

-- playlist
local order = {}
local function reshuffle()
	order = table.clone(cfg.Tracks)
	if cfg.Shuffle then
		for i = #order, 2, -1 do
			local j = math.random(i)
			order[i], order[j] = order[j], order[i]
		end
	end
end
local index = 0
local function nextId()
	index += 1
	if index > #order then
		local last = order[#order]
		reshuffle()
		if #order > 1 and order[1] == last then order[1], order[2] = order[2], order[1] end
		index = 1
	end
	return order[index]
end

local function newSound(id)
	local s = Instance.new("Sound")
	s.SoundId = id
	s.Volume = 0
	s.SoundGroup = group
	s.Parent = SoundService
	return s
end

task.spawn(function()
	if #cfg.Tracks == 0 then return end
	reshuffle()
	applyVolume(0)
	local current
	local holdForIntro = cfg.StartAfterIntro ~= false
	while true do
		local s = newSound(nextId())
		local t0 = os.clock()
		while not s.IsLoaded and os.clock() - t0 < 10 do task.wait(0.2) end
		if not s.IsLoaded or s.TimeLength <= 0 then
			s:Destroy() -- broken / moderated track: skip it
			task.wait(1)
		else
			if holdForIntro then
				-- loaded and ready: keep the very first track silent until the arrival cinematic is over.
				-- SnowIntro sets IntroReady when it finishes, is skipped or fails; 90 s cap so music can never be lost.
				holdForIntro = false
				local waitStart = os.clock()
				while player:GetAttribute("IntroReady") ~= true and os.clock() - waitStart < 90 do task.wait(0.1) end
			end
			s:Play()
			TweenService:Create(s, TweenInfo.new(cfg.Crossfade), {Volume = 1}):Play()
			if current then
				local old = current
				TweenService:Create(old, TweenInfo.new(cfg.Crossfade), {Volume = 0}):Play()
				task.delay(cfg.Crossfade + 0.1, function() old:Destroy() end)
			end
			current = s
			-- wait until it's time to start the next track (overlapping by the crossfade)
			task.wait(math.max(1, s.TimeLength - cfg.Crossfade))
		end
	end
end)

-- MachineLocksClient (2026-10-04, Claude): the lobby machines (Shovel Forge, Pet Fuser, Crafting Machine) look deep black and say
-- LOCKED until you own their unlock upgrade (UpgradeConfig.MachineUnlocks -> UnlockForge / UnlockFuser / UnlockCraft attributes).
-- Visual only; MachineService refuses locked machines on the server.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

	{Model = "ShovelForge", Attr = "UnlockForge", Label = "SHOVEL FORGE"},
	{Model = "PetFuser", Attr = "UnlockFuser", Label = "PET FUSER"},
	{Model = "CraftingMachine", Attr = "UnlockCraft", Label = "CRAFTING"},
}
local BLACK = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
-- "vanta black": black Neon ignores all lighting, so a locked machine is one flat silhouette (no shading, no edges)
local saved = {} -- strong table on purpose: weak Instance keys can be dropped while the part still exists
local function apply(model, label, locked)
	model:SetAttribute("LocalLocked", locked)
	for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") then
			if d.Transparency < 1 or (saved[d] and saved[d].T < 1) then
				if not saved[d] then saved[d] = {C = d.Color, M = d.Material, T = d.Transparency, R = d.Reflectance} end
				local s = saved[d]
				if locked then
					d.Color, d.Material, d.Transparency, d.Reflectance = BLACK, Enum.Material.Neon, 0, 0
				else
					d.Color, d.Material, d.Transparency, d.Reflectance = s.C, s.M, s.T, s.R
				end
			end
		elseif d:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or d:IsA("Light") or d:IsA("Beam") or d:IsA("Trail") or d:IsA("Fire") or d:IsA("Smoke") or d:IsA("Sparkles") then
			if saved[d] == nil then saved[d] = d.Enabled end
			d.Enabled = (not locked) and saved[d]
		elseif d:IsA("Decal") or d:IsA("Texture") then
			if saved[d] == nil then saved[d] = d.Transparency end
			d.Transparency = locked and 1 or saved[d]
		elseif d:IsA("SurfaceGui") then
			if saved[d] == nil then saved[d] = d.Enabled end
			d.Enabled = (not locked) and saved[d] -- no painted text on the silhouette
		elseif d:IsA("TextLabel") and d:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("BillboardGui") then
			if saved[d] == nil then saved[d] = d.Text end
			d.Text = locked and ("\u{1F512} " .. label) or saved[d] -- the floating sign still says what it is
		elseif d:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
			if saved[d] == nil then saved[d] = d.ActionText end
			d.ActionText = locked and "Locked" or saved[d]
		end
	end
end

	local village = workspace:WaitForChild("FrostfallVillage", 60)
	local model = village and village:WaitForChild(def.Model, 60)
	if not model then return end
	local function refresh() apply(model, def.Label, (tonumber(player:GetAttribute(def.Attr)) or 0) < 1) end

local function emitter(parent, props)
	local e = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	e.Texture, e.Rate, e.LightEmission, e.LightInfluence, e.Drag = TX.smoke, 0, 0.2, 0.3, 2
	e.Color = ColorSequence.new(WHITE, Color3.fromRGB(200, 232, 255))

end
local function attachFx(model)
	local out = {}
	local blade = model:FindFirstChild("Blade")
	local bladeRoot = blade and blade:FindFirstChild("Root")
	if bladeRoot then
		local a = Instance.new("Attachment"); a.Position = Vector3.new(0, -0.7, -2.4); a.Parent = bladeRoot
		out.blade = emitter(a, {Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.5, 0.9), Speed = NumberRange.new(6, 12), SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(55, 25), Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, 4, 0),
			Size = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1.2), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 3.4)}),
			Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.2), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1)})})
	end
	local b = Instance.new("Attachment"); b.Position = Vector3.new(0, -0.3, 4.2); b.Parent = model.PrimaryPart
	out.rear = emitter(b, {Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.6, 1.1), Speed = NumberRange.new(2, 5), SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(30, 20), Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, 2, 0),
		Size = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.8), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 2.4)}),

local folder = workspace:WaitForChild("Snowplows")
local fx, fxFor
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
	local model = folder:FindFirstChild("Snowplow_" .. player.UserId)
	local hull = model and model.PrimaryPart
	local hum = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not (hull and hum and hum.SeatPart and hum.SeatPart.Parent == model) then fxFor, fx = nil, nil return end
	if fxFor ~= model then fxFor = model; fx = attachFx(model) end
	local mv = moveVector()
	local throttle, steer = -mv.Z, mv.X
	local maxSpeed, accel = hull:GetAttribute("MaxSpeed") or 20, hull:GetAttribute("Accel") or 12
	local traction, turnRate = hull:GetAttribute("Traction") or 0.6, hull:GetAttribute("TurnRate") or 2
	local pivot, stability = hull:GetAttribute("Pivot") or 0.2, hull:GetAttribute("Stability") or 1
	local cf = hull.CFrame
	local look = Vector3.new(cf.LookVector.X, 0, cf.LookVector.Z)
	look = look.Magnitude > 0.05 and look.Unit or Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
	local right = Vector3.new(-look.Z, 0, look.X)
	local vel = hull.AssemblyLinearVelocity
	local fwd, lat = vel:Dot(look), vel:Dot(right)
	local target = throttle * maxSpeed * (throttle < 0 and C.Drive.ReverseFactor or 1)
	local rate = accel * (((target * fwd < 0) or math.abs(target) < math.abs(fwd)) and C.Drive.BrakeFactor or 1)
	fwd += math.clamp(target - fwd, -rate * dt, rate * dt)
	lat *= math.max(0, 1 - traction * C.Drive.LateralGrip * dt)
	local planar = look * fwd + right * lat
	hull.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(planar.X, vel.Y, planar.Z)
	local speedFactor = math.clamp(math.abs(fwd) / (maxSpeed * 0.35), math.max(C.Drive.MinTurn, pivot), 1)
	local yaw = -steer * turnRate * speedFactor * (fwd < -0.5 and -1 or 1)
	hull.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0, yaw, 0) + cf.UpVector:Cross(Vector3.yAxis) * (C.Drive.UprightAssist * stability)
	if fx then
		local speed = Vector3.new(vel.X, 0, vel.Z).Magnitude
		if fx.blade then fx.blade.Rate = math.clamp(speed * 2.2, 0, 42) end
		if fx.rear then fx.rear.Rate = math.clamp(speed * 1.1, 0, 22) end
	end
end)

local SCALE = 0.8        -- size of the shovels
local TILT = 8           -- degrees the arms tilt up at the tips (0 = perfectly flat)

local VIEW_DISTANCE = 220

-- Shiny mutation (2026-10-01): gold sparkles, plus a gold outline on your own shovels
local function addShine(m, own)
	local main, best = nil, 0
	for _, p in ipairs(m:GetDescendants()) do
		if p:IsA("BasePart") and p.Size.Magnitude > best then best = p.Size.Magnitude; main = p end
	end
	if main then
		local e = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
		e.Name = "ShinySparkles"
		e.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds"
		e.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 225, 110), Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255))
		e.LightEmission = 1
		e.Size = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.35), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0)})
		e.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.4, 0.8)
		e.Rate = 10
		e.Speed = NumberRange.new(0.5, 1.5)
		e.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180)
		e.Parent = main
	end
	local hl = m:FindFirstChildOfClass("Highlight")
	if hl and own then
		hl.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 60)
		hl.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 60)
		hl.FillTransparency = 0.75
	end

local function build(player)
	clear(player)
	local attr = player:GetAttribute("EquippedShovels") or ""
	local r = {shovels = {}}
	for name in attr:gmatch("[^,]+") do
		local item = Config.ByName[name]
		local size = item and item.Size or 1 -- Giant mutation
		local t = templates:FindFirstChild(item and item.Base or name) or templates:FindFirstChild(name) or templates:FindFirstChild("_Placeholder") -- placeholder until it has its own 3D model
		if t then
			local m = t:Clone()
			m:ScaleTo(SCALE * (player:GetAttribute("SizeMult") or 1) * size)
			-- outlines only on your own shovels (Roblox limits how many outlines can show)
			if player ~= localPlayer then
				local h = m:FindFirstChildOfClass("Highlight")
				if h then h:Destroy() end
			end
			if item and item.Mutations and table.find(item.Mutations, "Shiny") then addShine(m, player == localPlayer) end
			m.Parent = folder
			table.insert(r.shovels, {model = m, shown = true, size = size})
		end
	end
	rigs[player] = r
end

local t = 0
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
	t += dt
	local now = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	local camPos = workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position
	for player, r in pairs(rigs) do
		local char = player.Character
		local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local visible = root ~= nil and (root.Position - camPos).Magnitude < VIEW_DISTANCE and not (player == localPlayer and player:GetAttribute("IntroPlaying"))
		local n = #r.shovels
		for i, s in ipairs(r.shovels) do
			if not visible then
				if s.shown then s.model.Parent = nil; s.shown = false end
			else
				if not s.shown then s.model.Parent = folder; s.shown = true end
				-- fidget spinner: every shovel is a spoke, grip toward the player, blade pointing out
				local ang = now * SPEED * (player:GetAttribute("SpinMult") or 1) + (i - 1) * (2 * math.pi / n) + (player.UserId % 7)
				local out = Vector3.new(math.cos(ang), math.sin(math.rad(TILT)), math.sin(ang)).Unit
				local up = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
				local yAxis = -out                       -- shovel's +Y (grip) points at the hub
				local xAxis = yAxis:Cross(up).Unit       -- sideways, so the blade lies flat
				local zAxis = xAxis:Cross(yAxis)         -- blade face points up
				local center = root.Position + Vector3.new(0, HEIGHT, 0)
				local pos = center + out * (INNER + GRIP_FROM_PIVOT * (player:GetAttribute("SizeMult") or 1) * (s.size or 1)) * (player:GetAttribute("ReachMult") or 1)
				s.model:PivotTo(CFrame.fromMatrix(pos, xAxis, yAxis, zAxis))
			end
		end
	end
end)

local auras = {}
local function aura(plr, color, rarity)
	local char = plr.Character
	local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not hrp then return end
	if auras[plr] then pcall(function() auras[plr]:Destroy() end) end
	-- rarer = flashier preset from the VFX pack
	local preset = (rarity == "Secret" or rarity == "Divine") and "ElectricAura" or ((rarity == "Legendary" or rarity == "Mythic") and "MagicAura" or "IceAura")
	local ok, h = pcall(VFX.Attach, hrp, preset, {Color = color, Scale = 1.1})
	if ok then auras[plr] = h end
	pcall(VFX.Burst, hrp, "PowerUp", {Color = color, Scale = 1.2})
	local l = mk("PointLight", {Name = "RareAuraLight", Color = color, Range = 12, Brightness = 1.4}, hrp)
	task.delay(12, function()
		if ok and auras[plr] == h then h:SetEnabled(false); task.delay(2, function() pcall(function() h:Destroy() end) end); auras[plr] = nil end
		if l.Parent then TweenService:Create(l, TweenInfo.new(2), {Brightness = 0}):Play(); task.delay(2, function() l:Destroy() end) end
	end)
end

local function setPreview(vp, model, distMul)
	vp:ClearAllChildren()
	if not model then previews[vp] = nil return end
	model.Parent = vp
	local cf, size = model:GetBoundingBox()
	local cam = mk("Camera", {FieldOfView = 35}, vp)
	vp.CurrentCamera = cam
	previews[vp] = {cam = cam, center = cf.Position, dist = math.max(size.X, size.Y, size.Z) * (distMul or 1.7) + 2, h = size.Y * 0.18}
end

	end
end)

	if not state then return end
	local o, r = offerNow(), state.Reserved
	local isRes = target == "Reserved"
	local snow = snowNow()
	for _, g in ipairs({vp, nameL, rarPill, slotL, chanceL, descL, statL, priceL, needL, track, glow, buyB}) do g.Visible = o ~= nil end
	resB.Visible = o ~= nil and not isRes

	rerB.Label.Text = o and "REROLL" or "ROLL"
	if o then
		local def = C.Parts[o.Part]
		local col = RCOL[def.Rarity]
		hdr.BackgroundColor3 = col:Lerp(NAVY, 0.3)
		nameL.Text, rarL.Text, slotL.Text, chanceL.Text = def.Name, def.Rarity:upper(), def.Slot:upper(), chanceText(o.Part)

local function doRoll(key, inCard)
	key = key or target

	if r.ok then
		refreshAll()
		if inCard then -- rerolled from the open card: it stays open
			target = key
			showCard(true)
			reveal(r.rank or 2)
		else -- rolled at the pedestal: no pop-up - the part appears on its pedestal (E there opens the offer, R rerolls)
			Api.Revealed(key, r.rank or 2)
			local o = state and state.Offers and state.Offers[key]
			if o then
				local def = C.Parts[o.Part]
				toast(("%s - %s  \u{2744}%s"):format(def.Name, def.Rarity, Format.Abbreviate(o.Price)), RCOL[def.Rarity]:Lerp(WHITE, 0.3))
			end
		end
	else

	end
end

-- EggFloat (RunContext = Client): smooth idle float + sway, playful hop-wiggles with a sparkle burst,
-- the nearest egg lifts and turns toward the player, glow pulse, and "COMING SOON" labels that fade by distance.
-- Only the visual Shell moves; HatchAnchor (prompt / odds sign) stays still.
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local display = script.Parent
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local rng = Random.new()
local centre = display:GetPivot().Position

local list, known = {}, {}
local function add(model)
	if not model:IsA("Model") or known[model] then return end
	local shell, anchor = model:FindFirstChild("Shell"), model:FindFirstChild("HatchAnchor")
	if not (shell and anchor) then return end
	known[model] = true
	local label = anchor:FindFirstChild("ComingSoon")
	local text = label and label:FindFirstChildOfClass("TextLabel")
	local fx = model:FindFirstChild("FxVolume")
	local raysAtt = fx and fx:FindFirstChild("RaysAtt")
	table.insert(list, {
		shell = shell, anchor = anchor, base = shell.CFrame,
		phase = (model:GetAttribute("Order") or #list + 1) * 0.9,
		lift = 0, turn = 0, hop = -1, nextHop = os.clock() + rng:NextNumber(2.5, 8),
		light = anchor:FindFirstChild("EggGlow"), pad = model:FindFirstChild("GlowPad"),
		sparkle = (fx and fx:FindFirstChild("Sparkle")) or anchor:FindFirstChild("Sparkle"),
		rays = raysAtt and raysAtt:FindFirstChild("Rays"), raysOn = false,
		label = label, text = text, stroke = text and text:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke"), labelAlpha = 0,
	})
end
for _, m in ipairs(display:GetChildren()) do add(m) end
display.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d)
	if d.Parent and (d.Name == "Shell" or d.Name == "HatchAnchor") then task.defer(add, d.Parent) end
end)

local function ease(cur, target, speed, dt) return cur + (target - cur) * (1 - math.exp(-speed * dt)) end
local HOP_TIME, NEAR, LABEL_NEAR, RANGE = 0.9, 13, 22, 220
local parts, cframes = {}, {}

RunService.PreRender:Connect(function(dt)
	dt = math.min(dt, 0.1)
	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not cam or (cam.CFrame.Position - centre).Magnitude > RANGE then return end
	local t = os.clock()
	local char = player.Character
	local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

	local nearest, nd = nil, NEAR
	if hrp then
		for _, e in ipairs(list) do
			local d = (Vector3.new(hrp.Position.X, 0, hrp.Position.Z) - Vector3.new(e.anchor.Position.X, 0, e.anchor.Position.Z)).Magnitude
			if d < nd then nearest, nd = e, d end
		end
	end

	table.clear(parts); table.clear(cframes)
	for _, e in ipairs(list) do
		if e.shell.Parent then
			local p = t * 1.2 + e.phase
			local bob = (math.sin(p) * 0.5 + 0.5) * 0.38
			local lean = math.cos(p) * 0.035
			local sway = math.sin(t * 0.33 + e.phase) * 0.12

			local wantLift, wantTurn = 0, 0
			if e == nearest then
				wantLift = 0.55
				local rel = e.base:PointToObjectSpace(hrp.Position)
				wantTurn = math.clamp(math.atan2(-rel.X, -rel.Z), -0.6, 0.6)
			end
			e.lift = ease(e.lift, wantLift, 4, dt)
			e.turn = ease(e.turn, wantTurn, 3, dt)

			-- light beams rise behind the egg you are standing at
			local wantRays = e == nearest
			if e.rays and wantRays ~= e.raysOn then
				e.raysOn = wantRays
				e.rays.Rate = wantRays and 1.4 or 0
				if wantRays then e.rays:Emit(1) end
			end

			if e.hop < 0 and t >= e.nextHop then
				e.hop = 0
				e.nextHop = t + rng:NextNumber(6, 11)
				if e.sparkle then e.sparkle:Emit(8) end
			end
			local hopY, wig = 0, 0
			if e.hop >= 0 then
				e.hop += dt
				local k = e.hop / HOP_TIME
				if k >= 1 then
					e.hop = -1
				else
					hopY = math.sin(k * math.pi) ^ 1.5 * 0.6
					wig = math.sin(k * math.pi * 4) * 0.17 * (1 - k) ^ 2
				end
			end

			table.insert(parts, e.shell)
			table.insert(cframes, e.base * CFrame.new(0, bob + e.lift + hopY, 0) * CFrame.Angles(lean, sway + e.turn, wig))

			local glow = 0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(p * 0.8)
			if e.light then e.light.Brightness = 0.7 + glow * 0.5 + e.lift * 0.8 end
			if e.pad then e.pad.Transparency = 0.72 - glow * 0.14 - e.lift * 0.15 end

			if e.label and e.text then
				local close = hrp and (hrp.Position - e.anchor.Position).Magnitude < LABEL_NEAR
				e.labelAlpha = ease(e.labelAlpha, close and 1 or 0, 6, dt)
				e.label.Enabled = e.labelAlpha > 0.02
				e.text.TextTransparency = 1 - e.labelAlpha
				if e.stroke then e.stroke.Transparency = 1 - e.labelAlpha end
			end
		end
	end
	if #parts > 0 then workspace:BulkMoveTo(parts, cframes, Enum.BulkMoveMode.FireCFrameChanged) end
end)

local baseGlowT = outerGlow.Transparency
local baseBright = coreLight and coreLight.Brightness or 2

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
	t += dt
	-- skip the work when the player is far away
	if (camera.CFrame.Position - centerCF.Position).Magnitude > 600 then return end

	-- spiral layers: negative speed spins clockwise, which makes the arms read as pulling inward
	for _, h in ipairs(hubs) do
		h.part.CFrame = h.base * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, h.speed * t)
	end

	for _, s in ipairs(shards) do
		s.m:PivotTo(s.base * CFrame.new(0, math.sin(t * 1.3 + s.phase) * 0.9, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, t * 0.6 + s.phase, 0))
	end

	for _, w in ipairs(wisps) do
		local a = math.rad(90) + math.rad(118) * math.sin(t * 0.55 + w.phase)
		w.p.CFrame = centerCF * CFrame.new(R * math.cos(a), R * math.sin(a), WZ)
	end

	local pulse = (math.sin(t * 2.2) + 1) / 2
	outerGlow.Transparency = baseGlowT + 0.12 * pulse
	if coreLight then coreLight.Brightness = baseBright + 0.6 * (1 - pulse) end
end)

-- SnowFieldClient: builds the snow tiles locally and animates changes sent by the server.
-- Fields are STREAMED: only fields near you are built (a few hundred tiles per frame), far ones are removed.
-- The LOOK of the tiles comes from ReplicatedStorage > SnowStages > <Stage>:
--   Phase3 / Phase2 / Phase1 : Material, MaterialVariant, Color, Transparency, Reflectance, and HEIGHT (Size.Y)
--   Floor                    : the field floor (Size.Y = thickness)
--   Puff                     : particle emitters burst on every scrape (attribute EmitCount per emitter)
--   folder attributes        : Gap, HeightJitter

local TS = SF.TileSize
local BUILD_DISTANCE = 170     -- build a field when you're this close to its edge
local UNLOAD_DISTANCE = 240    -- remove it when you're this far
local TILES_PER_FRAME = 250    -- spread building over frames (no stutter)

local root = Instance.new("Folder")
root.Name = "SnowFieldsVisual"
root.Parent = workspace

local function lockDown(p)
	p.Anchored = true
	p.CanCollide = false
	p.CanQuery = false
	p.CanTouch = false
end

--------------------------------------------------
-- STYLES
--------------------------------------------------
local styleCache = {}
local function getStyle(name)
	if styleCache[name] then return styleCache[name] end
	local s = stylesFolder:FindFirstChild(name or "Starter") or stylesFolder:WaitForChild("Starter")
	local st = {
		phases = {},
		floor = s:FindFirstChild("Floor"),
		puff = s:FindFirstChild("Puff"),
		gap = s:GetAttribute("Gap") or 0.15,
		jitter = s:GetAttribute("HeightJitter") or 0.18,
	}
	for p = 1, SF.MaxPhase do st.phases[p] = s:WaitForChild("Phase" .. p) end
	styleCache[name] = st
	return st
end

--------------------------------------------------
-- FIELD DATA (always kept) + VISUALS (only when near)
--------------------------------------------------
local fields = {}
for _, f in ipairs(SF.Fields) do
	local n = f.Width * f.Depth
	local fd = {def = f, style = getStyle(f.Style or "Starter"), phases = table.create(n, SF.MaxPhase), hp = table.create(n, 100),
		jitter = {}, built = false, building = false}
	for i = 1, n do fd.jitter[i] = (math.random() - 0.5) * fd.style.jitter end
	local o = SF.Origin(f)
	fd.minX, fd.minZ = o.X, o.Z
	fd.maxX, fd.maxZ = o.X + f.Width * TS, o.Z + f.Depth * TS
	fields[f.Id] = fd
end

local function heightOf(style, p, jitter)
	if p <= 0 then return 0.1 end
	return style.phases[p].Size.Y + jitter
end

local function tileCenter(fd, i)
	local f = fd.def
	local x = (i - 1) % f.Width
	local z = (i - 1) // f.Width
	return SF.TileCenter(f, x, z)
end

local function apply(fd, i, p, animate, growing)
	local part = fd.parts[i]
	if not part then return end
	local style = fd.style
	local h = heightOf(style, p, fd.jitter[i])
	if p > 0 then
		-- damaged layers sink toward the layer below (100% HP = full height)
		local lower = p > 1 and heightOf(style, p - 1, fd.jitter[i]) or 0.1
		local frac = (fd.hp[i] or 100) / 100
		h = lower + (h - lower) * (0.3 + 0.7 * frac)
	end
	local tp = style.phases[math.max(p, 1)]
	part.Material = tp.Material
	part.MaterialVariant = tp.MaterialVariant
	part.Reflectance = tp.Reflectance
	local g = {
		Size = Vector3.new(TS - style.gap, h, TS - style.gap),
		CFrame = CFrame.new(fd.centers[i] + Vector3.new(0, fd.floorTop + h / 2, 0)),
		Color = tp.Color,
		Transparency = p <= 0 and 1 or tp.Transparency,
	}
	if animate then
		local info = growing and TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
			or TweenInfo.new(0.16, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
		TweenService:Create(part, info, g):Play()
	else
		for k, v in pairs(g) do part[k] = v end
	end
end

local function puff(fd, pos, big)
	if not fd.puff then return end
	fd.puff.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos)
	for _, e in ipairs(fd.puff:GetChildren()) do
		if e:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
			local n = e:GetAttribute("EmitCount") or 2
			e:Emit(big and n + 1 or n)
		end
	end
end

local function hitPuff(fd, pos)
	if not fd.puff then return end
	fd.puff.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos)
	for _, e in ipairs(fd.puff:GetChildren()) do
		if e:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then e:Emit(1) end
	end
end

local function buildVisual(fd)
	if fd.built or fd.building then return end
	fd.building = true
	local f, style = fd.def, fd.style
	local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = f.Id
	fd.folder = folder
	fd.floorTop = 0
	if style.floor then
		local floor = style.floor:Clone()
		floor.Name = "FieldFloor"
		lockDown(floor)
		floor.Size = Vector3.new(f.Width * TS + 0.8, style.floor.Size.Y, f.Depth * TS + 0.8)
		floor.CFrame = CFrame.new(f.Center + Vector3.new(0, style.floor.Size.Y / 2, 0))
		floor.Parent = folder
		fd.floorTop = style.floor.Size.Y
	end
	if style.puff then
		fd.puff = style.puff:Clone()
		lockDown(fd.puff)
		fd.puff.Transparency = 1
		fd.puff.Parent = folder
	end
	fd.parts, fd.centers = {}, {}
	folder.Parent = root
	local base = style.phases[SF.MaxPhase]
	local n = f.Width * f.Depth
	for i = 1, n do
		if not fd.building then return end -- unloaded while building
		local part = base:Clone()
		part.Name = "Snow"
		lockDown(part)
		part.CastShadow = false
		fd.centers[i] = tileCenter(fd, i)
		fd.parts[i] = part
		apply(fd, i, fd.phases[i], false)
		part.Parent = folder
		if i % TILES_PER_FRAME == 0 then task.wait() end
	end
	fd.building = false
	fd.built = true
end

local function destroyVisual(fd)
	fd.building = false
	fd.built = false
	if fd.folder then fd.folder:Destroy() end
	fd.folder, fd.parts, fd.centers, fd.puff = nil, nil, nil, nil
end

-- server updates: always update the data, animate only if the field is built
updateEvent.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(id, flat)
	local fd = fields[id]
	if not fd then return end
	for j = 1, #flat, 3 do
		local i, p, hp = flat[j], flat[j + 1], flat[j + 2]
		local old, oldHp = fd.phases[i], fd.hp[i]
		if old and (p ~= old or hp ~= oldHp) then
			fd.phases[i] = p
			fd.hp[i] = hp
			if fd.built then
				apply(fd, i, p, true, p > old)
				local top = fd.centers[i] + Vector3.new(0, fd.floorTop + heightOf(fd.style, math.max(old, 1), 0), 0)
				if p < old then
					puff(fd, top, old == SF.MaxPhase)      -- layer broke
				elseif p == old and hp < oldHp then
					hitPuff(fd, top)                       -- just damaged
				end
			end
		end
	end
end)

task.spawn(function()
	for _ = 1, 10 do
		local ok, res = pcall(function() return syncFunc:InvokeServer() end)
		if ok and type(res) == "table" then
			for id, data in pairs(res) do
				local fd = fields[id]
				if fd and type(data) == "table" then
					local str = data.p or ""
					for i = 1, #str do
						local p = tonumber(str:sub(i, i))
						if p then
							fd.phases[i] = p
							fd.hp[i] = data.h and data.h[i] or 100
							if fd.built then apply(fd, i, p, false) end
						end
					end
				end
			end
			return
		end
		task.wait(1)
	end
end)

-- streaming loop
task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		local char = player.Character
		local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local pos = hrp and hrp.Position or workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position
		for _, fd in pairs(fields) do
			local dx = math.max(fd.minX - pos.X, 0, pos.X - fd.maxX)
			local dz = math.max(fd.minZ - pos.Z, 0, pos.Z - fd.maxZ)
			local dist = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz)
			if dist < BUILD_DISTANCE and not fd.built and not fd.building then
				task.spawn(buildVisual, fd)
			elseif dist > UNLOAD_DISTANCE and (fd.built or fd.building) then
				destroyVisual(fd)
			end
		end
		task.wait(0.5)
	end
end)

local function isOpen(id) return id == "Starter" or player:GetAttribute("Stage_" .. id) == true end

local function refresh(w)
	local s = S.ById[w.stage]
	if not s or not w.part.Parent then return end
	if isOpen(w.stage) then
		if not w.opened then
			w.opened = true
			w.part.CanCollide = false
			if w.gui then w.gui.Enabled = false end
			if w.fade then w.fade:Cancel() end
   w.fade = TweenService:Create(w.part, TweenInfo.new(0.6), {Transparency = 1})
   w.fade:Play()
		end
		return
	end
	w.opened = false
	if w.fade then w.fade:Cancel(); w.fade = nil end
	w.part.Transparency = w.baseTransparency
	w.part.CanCollide = true
	if w.gui then w.gui.Enabled = true end
	if w.title then w.title.Text = s.Name:upper() end
	local prev = S.Previous(w.stage)
	if prev and not isOpen(prev.Id) then
		if w.cost then w.cost.Text = "Unlock " .. prev.Name .. " first" end
		if w.button then w.button.Text = "LOCKED"; w.button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 125, 140) end
	else
		if w.cost then w.cost.Text = "❄ " .. NumberFormat.Abbreviate(s.Cost) end
		if w.button then w.button.Text = "UNLOCK"; w.button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 210, 90) end
	end
end

local pending = {} -- 2026-10-02 (Claude): a wall whose part streams in late is registered when the part arrives
local function register(model)
	if walls[model] or pending[model] or not model:GetAttribute("Stage") then return end
	pending[model] = true
	local part = model:WaitForChild("Stage paywall", 10)
	pending[model] = nil
	if not part or walls[model] then return end
	local w = {stage = model:GetAttribute("Stage"), part = part, baseTransparency = part.Transparency}
	w.gui = part:FindFirstChild("PaywallSurface")
	if w.gui then
		for _, d in ipairs(w.gui:GetDescendants()) do
			if d:IsA("TextLabel") then
				if d.Name == "CostLabel" then w.cost = d
				elseif d.Text:find("LOCKED") then w.title = d end
			elseif d:IsA("TextButton") and d.Name == "UnlockButton" then
				w.button = d
			end
		end
	end
	if w.button then
		w.button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			if isOpen(w.stage) then return end
			local ok, res, msg = pcall(function() return unlock:InvokeServer(w.stage) end)
			if ok and res == true then
				showToast("🎉 " .. S.ById[w.stage].Name .. " unlocked!", Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 140))
			else
				showToast(tostring(ok and msg or "Try again"), Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 120))
			end
		end)
	end
	walls[model] = w
	model.AncestryChanged:Connect(function() if not model.Parent then walls[model] = nil end end)
	refresh(w)
end

-- smooth arrow (rounded shaft + chevron head); the arrow's TIP is at the centre of its frame
local function makeArrow(parent, len, thick)
	local a = mk("Frame", {Name = "Arrow", BackgroundTransparency = 1, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(len * 2, len * 2), ZIndex = 7}, parent)
	local function bar(x, y, w, rot, color, z, tr)
		local b = mk("Frame", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, thick),
			Rotation = rot, BackgroundColor3 = color, BackgroundTransparency = tr or 0, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = z}, a)
		mk("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)}, b)
	end
	local head = len * 0.45
	local ang = math.rad(40)
	for _, layer in ipairs({{3, Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 7, 0.6}, {0, WHITE, 8, 0}}) do -- soft shadow, then white
		local o, col, z, tr = layer[1], layer[2], layer[3], layer[4]
		bar(len - len * 0.45 + o, len + o, len * 0.9, 0, col, z, tr)
		bar(len - head / 2 * math.cos(ang) + o, len - head / 2 * math.sin(ang) + o, head, 40, col, z, tr)
		bar(len - head / 2 * math.cos(ang) + o, len + head / 2 * math.sin(ang) + o, head, -40, col, z, tr)
	end
	return a
end

	Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)}, nil)
local worldAtt = mk("Attachment", {}, worldPart)

--------------------------------------------------
-- helpers
--------------------------------------------------
local target -- GuiObject the UI arrow points at
local worldOn = false
local t0 = 0

local function say(text)
	label.Text = text
	boxScale.Scale = 0.85
	tween(boxScale, 0.35, {Scale = 1}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
end
local function pointAt(gui)
	target = gui
	uiArrow.Visible = gui ~= nil
end
local function pointWorld(pos)
	if pos then
		worldPart.Position = pos
		worldPart.Parent = workspace
		local char = player.Character
		local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if hrp then
			local a0 = hrp:FindFirstChild("TutorialAtt") or mk("Attachment", {Name = "TutorialAtt", Position = Vector3.new(0, -2.5, 0)}, hrp)
			beam.Attachment0 = a0
			beam.Enabled = true
		end
		worldOn = true
	else
		worldPart.Parent = nil
		beam.Enabled = false
		worldOn = false
	end
end

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	if not sg.Enabled then return end
	t0 += 1 / 60
	-- UI arrow glides next to its target and bounces toward it
	if target and target.Parent and target.Visible and target.AbsoluteSize.Magnitude > 0 then
		uiArrow.Visible = true
		local c = target.AbsolutePosition + target.AbsoluteSize / 2 + Vector2.new(0, game:GetService("GuiService"):GetGuiInset().Y)
		local screen = camera.ViewportSize / 2
		local dir = (screen - c)
		dir = dir.Magnitude > 1 and dir.Unit or Vector2.new(0, -1)
		local r = math.max(target.AbsoluteSize.X, target.AbsoluteSize.Y) / 2 + 12
		local bounce = (math.sin(t0 * 6) + 1) * 7
		local tip = c + dir * (r + bounce)
		local goal = UDim2.fromOffset(tip.X, tip.Y)
		uiArrow.Position = uiArrow.Position:Lerp(goal, 0.25)
		uiArrow.Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(-dir.Y, -dir.X))
	elseif target then
		uiArrow.Visible = false
	end
	if worldOn then
		worldArrow.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.75, -math.abs(math.sin(t0 * 5)) * 18)
		beam.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0.3 + (math.sin(t0 * 4) + 1) * 0.15)
	end
end)

--------------------------------------------------
-- STEPS
--------------------------------------------------
local running = false
local cancelled = false

local function waitUntil(fn)
	while not fn() do
		if cancelled then return false end
		task.wait(0.1)
	end
	return not cancelled
end

local function finish()
	pointAt(nil)
	pointWorld(nil)
	tween(box, 0.3, {BackgroundTransparency = 1})
	tween(label, 0.3, {TextTransparency = 1})
	task.wait(0.3)
	sg.Enabled = false
	box.BackgroundTransparency = 0.35
	label.TextTransparency = 0
	running = false
	player:SetAttribute("TutorialDone", true)
	setSetting:FireServer("TutorialDone", true)
end

local function run()
	if running then return end
	running = true
	cancelled = false
	-- Wait for startup too: IntroPlaying is still nil while the avatar loads.
	local intro = player.PlayerScripts:FindFirstChild("SnowIntro")
	if intro and intro.Enabled then
		if not waitUntil(function() return player:GetAttribute("IntroReady") == true end) then return end
	end
	if not waitUntil(function() return player:GetAttribute("IntroPlaying") ~= true end) then return end
	task.wait(1)
	if not waitUntil(function() return player:GetAttribute("IntroPlaying") ~= true end) then return end
	sg.Enabled = true

	local bottom = rngGui:WaitForChild("BottomBar")
	local rollB = bottom:WaitForChild("RollButton")
	local upB = bottom:WaitForChild("UpgradesButton")

	-- 1) roll
	say("Your "..(player:GetAttribute("StarterShovelName") or "Tin Shovel").." is ready!\nTap the dice to roll another shovel!")
	pointAt(rollB)
	local rolled = false
	local conn = rngGui:WaitForChild("RollFinished").Event:Connect(function() rolled = true end)
	if not waitUntil(function() return rolled end) then conn:Disconnect() return end
	conn:Disconnect()

	-- 2) the spinner
	pointAt(nil)
	say("Nice! Your shovel spins around you ❄")
	task.wait(2.8)
	if cancelled then return end

	-- 3) dig in the snow field
	local SF = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("SnowFields"))
	local field
	for _, f in ipairs(SF.Fields) do if f.Id == "FrostfallSnowYard" then field = f break end end
	if not field then
		for _, f in ipairs(SF.Fields) do if f.Id == "Starter" or f.Style == "Starter" then field = f break end end
	end
	local snow = player:WaitForChild("leaderstats"):WaitForChild("Snow")
	local start = snow.Value
	local GOAL = 10
	if field then pointWorld(field.Center + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)) end
	local function progress() return math.clamp(snow.Value - start, 0, GOAL) end
	say("Walk into the snow to dig!  0/" .. GOAL .. " ❄")
	local c2 = snow.Changed:Connect(function()
		label.Text = "Walk into the snow to dig!  " .. progress() .. "/" .. GOAL .. " ❄"
	end)
	if not waitUntil(function() return progress() >= GOAL end) then c2:Disconnect() return end
	c2:Disconnect()
	pointWorld(nil)

	-- 4) upgrades
	say("Great! Spend snow on upgrades!")
	pointAt(upB)
	local tree = pg:WaitForChild("UpgradeTreeGui", 30)
	if not waitUntil(function() return tree and tree.Enabled end) then return end
	pointAt(nil)

	-- 5) done
	say("Roll rarer shovels and unlock new areas.\nHave fun!")
	task.wait(3.2)
	finish()
end

skip.Activated:Connect(function()
	cancelled = true
	finish()
end)

local function check()
	if player:GetAttribute("TutorialDone") == false and not running then task.spawn(run) end
end
player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("TutorialDone"):Connect(check)
check()

-- Quiet local scenic movement. Only animate nearby streamed scenery, at most 25 updates/sec.
-- StageDecorMotion kinds: (default) vertical bob, "Water" sliding streak, "Sway" gentle tilt about the pivot (plants),
-- "Orbit" circle around the start point (birds; MotionRadius), "Roll" roll back and forth along local X (tumbleweeds; MotionRadius).
local RunService=game:GetService("RunService")
-- 2026-10-02 (Claude): also animates World 2 scenery (Workspace.World2). Extra kind "Spin": turns about MotionAxis X/Y/Z at MotionSpeed rad/s.
local roots={}
do local r=workspace:WaitForChild("StageDecor20260930",30);if r then table.insert(roots,r)end
 local w2=workspace:FindFirstChild("World2")or workspace:WaitForChild("World2",10);if w2 then table.insert(roots,w2)end end
if #roots==0 then return end
local root=roots[1]
local function inRoots(o)for _,r in ipairs(roots)do if o:IsDescendantOf(r)then return true end end return false end
local entries={};local registered=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"});local particles={}
local function register(o)
 if o:IsA("ParticleEmitter")then particles[o]=true end
 local kind=o:GetAttribute("StageDecorMotion")
 if not kind or registered[o]or not(o:IsA("BasePart")or o:IsA("Model"))then return end
 registered[o]=true
 local cf=o:IsA("Model")and o:GetPivot()or o.CFrame
 table.insert(entries,{object=o,base=cf,kind=kind,amount=o:GetAttribute("MotionAmount")or .3,
  speed=o:GetAttribute("MotionSpeed")or .8,phase=o:GetAttribute("MotionPhase")or 0,radius=o:GetAttribute("MotionRadius")or 20})
 script:SetAttribute("AnimatedCount",#entries)
end
for _,r in ipairs(roots)do for _,o in r:GetDescendants()do register(o)end;r.DescendantAdded:Connect(register)end
local elapsed,nextFrame,particleTick=0,0,0
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
 elapsed+=dt;nextFrame+=dt;particleTick+=dt
 if nextFrame<.04 then return end;nextFrame=0
 local camera=workspace.CurrentCamera;if not camera then return end
 local view=camera.CFrame.Position
 for i=#entries,1,-1 do
  local e=entries[i];local o=e.object
  if not inRoots(o)then table.remove(entries,i);registered[o]=nil
  elseif(view-e.base.Position).Magnitude<((e.kind=="Orbit"or e.kind=="Loop")and 200+e.radius or 200)then
   local cf;local t=elapsed*e.speed+e.phase
   if e.kind=="Water"then cf=CFrame.new(0,(((e.phase-elapsed*e.speed/e.amount)%1)-.5)*e.amount,0)*e.base
   elseif e.kind=="Sway"then cf=e.base*CFrame.Angles(math.sin(t)*e.amount,0,math.sin(t*.73+1.3)*e.amount*.6)
   elseif e.kind=="Orbit"then
    local p=e.base.Position+Vector3.new(math.cos(t)*e.radius,math.sin(t*2.3)*e.amount,math.sin(t)*e.radius)
    cf=CFrame.lookAt(p,p+Vector3.new(-math.sin(t),0,math.cos(t)))*CFrame.Angles(0,0,-.3)
   elseif e.kind=="Roll"then
    local x=math.sin(t)*e.radius
    cf=e.base*CFrame.new(x,math.abs(math.sin(t*5))*e.amount,0)*CFrame.Angles(0,0,-x/1.3)
   elseif e.kind=="Loop"then -- 2026-10-03 (Claude): level circle, no banking (toy train); centre = LoopCenter attribute or the start point
    local c=o:GetAttribute("LoopCenter")or e.base.Position
    local p=Vector3.new(c.X+math.cos(t)*e.radius,e.base.Position.Y,c.Z+math.sin(t)*e.radius)
    cf=CFrame.lookAt(p,p+Vector3.new(-math.sin(t),0,math.cos(t)))
   elseif e.kind=="Spin"then
    local ax=o:GetAttribute("MotionAxis")or"Y";local a=elapsed*e.speed+e.phase
    cf=e.base*(ax=="X"and CFrame.Angles(a,0,0)or ax=="Z"and CFrame.Angles(0,0,a)or CFrame.Angles(0,a,0))
   else cf=CFrame.new(0,math.sin(t)*e.amount,0)*e.base end
   if o:IsA("Model")then o:PivotTo(cf)else o.CFrame=cf end
  end
 end
 if particleTick>.4 then
  particleTick=0
  for e in particles do
   if not e:IsDescendantOf(root)then particles[e]=nil
   else local a=e.Parent;local part=a and a.Parent
    if part and part:IsA("BasePart")then e.Enabled=(view-part.Position).Magnitude<160 end
   end
  end
 end
end)

-- Client-only snowy skin and branded prompts. Existing services own all actions.
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local RS=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local PromptService=game:GetService("ProximityPromptService")
local TweenService=game:GetService("TweenService")
local UIS=game:GetService("UserInputService")

local pg=Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
UI.Attach(pg)
UI.Attach(workspace)
local function make(class,props,parent)
	local o=Instance.new(class) for k,v in pairs(props) do o[k]=v end o.Parent=parent return o
end
local function label(parent,text,pos,size,color)
	local t=make("TextLabel",{BackgroundTransparency=1,Font=Enum.Font.FredokaOne,Text=text,TextScaled=true,
		TextColor3=color or Color3.new(1,1,1),Position=pos,Size=size,ZIndex=3},parent)
	make("UIStroke",{Color=Color3.fromRGB(17,49,83),Thickness=1.5},t) return t
end
local views={}
local function customPrompt(o)
	if o:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and (o.Style==Enum.ProximityPromptStyle.Default or o:GetAttribute("SnowUIOwnPrompt")) then
		o:SetAttribute("SnowUIOwnPrompt",true) o.Style=Enum.ProximityPromptStyle.Custom
	end
end
PromptService.PromptShown:Connect(function(prompt,inputType)
	if not prompt:GetAttribute("SnowUIOwnPrompt") or views[prompt] then return end
	local parent=prompt.Parent
	local part=parent and (parent:IsA("BasePart") and parent or parent:IsA("Attachment") and parent.Parent
		or parent:IsA("Model") and (parent.PrimaryPart or parent:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart",true)))
	if not part then return end
	-- 2026-10-03 (Claude): AlwaysOnTop billboards do not render in this place (tested), so the card is a normal billboard
	local gui=make("BillboardGui",{Name="SnowPrompt",Adornee=part,AlwaysOnTop=false,LightInfluence=0,Active=true,
		Size=UDim2.fromOffset(248,80),StudsOffsetWorldSpace=Vector3.new(0,3.4,0),MaxDistance=1e5},pg) -- 2026-10-03 (Claude): BillboardGui.MaxDistance is measured from the CAMERA; the old limit (reach+4) hid the card behind a normal third-person camera. PromptShown/Hidden already control when it shows.
	local body=make("Frame",{Name="Body",BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(20,84,146),BackgroundTransparency=0.08,
		Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),BorderSizePixel=0,ZIndex=1},gui)
	make("UICorner",{CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,14)},body) UI.Skin(body,"card")
	-- 2026-10-03 (Claude): bigger 3D key cap that gently pulses, so players see which key to press
	local keyShadow=make("Frame",{Name="KeyShadow",BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(10,42,85),Position=UDim2.fromScale(0.045,0.2),
		Size=UDim2.fromScale(0.2,0.66),BorderSizePixel=0,ZIndex=2},body)
	make("UICorner",{CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,10)},keyShadow)
	local key=make("Frame",{Name="Key",BackgroundColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1),Position=UDim2.fromScale(0.045,0.13),
		Size=UDim2.fromScale(0.2,0.66),BorderSizePixel=0,ZIndex=3},body)
	make("UICorner",{CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,10)},key)
	make("UIStroke",{Color=Color3.fromRGB(17,49,83),Thickness=2.5,ApplyStrokeMode=Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border},key)
	make("UIGradient",{Rotation=90,Color=ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1,1,1),Color3.fromRGB(190,236,255))},key)
	local keyScale=make("UIScale",{Scale=1},key)
	local word=inputType==Enum.ProximityPromptInputType.Touch and "TAP"
		or inputType==Enum.ProximityPromptInputType.Gamepad and prompt.GamepadKeyCode.Name or prompt.KeyboardKeyCode.Name
	local keyText=label(key,word,UDim2.fromScale(0.08,0.08),UDim2.fromScale(0.84,0.84),Color3.fromRGB(21,60,99))
	keyText.ZIndex=4
	local pulse=TweenService:Create(keyScale,TweenInfo.new(0.55,Enum.EasingStyle.Sine,Enum.EasingDirection.InOut,-1,true),{Scale=1.12})
	pulse:Play()
	local title=label(body,prompt.ActionText,UDim2.fromScale(0.27,0.12),UDim2.fromScale(0.68,0.42))
	local sub=label(body,prompt.ObjectText,UDim2.fromScale(0.27,0.55),UDim2.fromScale(0.68,0.26),Color3.fromRGB(173,233,255))
	local track=make("Frame",{BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(10,42,85),BorderSizePixel=0,Position=UDim2.fromScale(0.27,0.87),
		Size=UDim2.fromScale(0.66,0.055),ZIndex=3,Visible=prompt.HoldDuration>0},body)
	local fill=make("Frame",{Name="Fill",Size=UDim2.fromScale(0,1),BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(120,245,255),BorderSizePixel=0,ZIndex=4},track)
	local hit=make("TextButton",{Name="Hit",Text="",BackgroundTransparency=1,Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),Active=true,Selectable=false,ZIndex=8},body)
	local connections,held,activeInput,tween={},false,nil,nil
	local function release(input)
		if held and (not input or input==activeInput) then
			held=false activeInput=nil if prompt.Parent then prompt:InputHoldEnd() end
		end
	end
	table.insert(connections,hit.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			if not held then held,activeInput=true,input prompt:InputHoldBegin() end
		end
	end))
	table.insert(connections,UIS.InputEnded:Connect(release))
	table.insert(connections,prompt:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ActionText"):Connect(function() title.Text=prompt.ActionText end))
	table.insert(connections,prompt:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ObjectText"):Connect(function() sub.Text=prompt.ObjectText end))
	table.insert(connections,prompt.PromptButtonHoldBegan:Connect(function()
		if tween then tween:Cancel() end fill.Size=UDim2.fromScale(0,1)
		tween=TweenService:Create(fill,TweenInfo.new(prompt.HoldDuration,Enum.EasingStyle.Linear),{Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1)}) tween:Play()
	end))
	table.insert(connections,prompt.PromptButtonHoldEnded:Connect(function()
		if tween then tween:Cancel() end fill.Size=UDim2.fromScale(0,1)
	end))
	views[prompt]=function()
		release() if tween then tween:Cancel() end pulse:Cancel() for _,c in ipairs(connections) do c:Disconnect() end gui:Destroy()
	end
end)
PromptService.PromptHidden:Connect(function(prompt)
	local cleanup=views[prompt] if cleanup then views[prompt]=nil cleanup() end
end)
for _,o in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do customPrompt(o) end
